arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ سَاعَةً لاَ يُوَافِقُهَا عَبْدٌ مُسْلِمٌ يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ خَيْرًا إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: In the night there is an hour in which no Muslim servant asks Allah for good except that He gives it to him. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Salamah ibn Shabib narrated to me; al-Hasan ibn A'yan narrated to us; Ma'qil narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "There is an hour during the night in which no Muslim servant asks Allah for good without Him giving it to him."

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ يَقُمْ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فَيُوَافِقُهَا - أُرَاهُ قَالَ - إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Hurayra reported from the Prophet (peace be upon him): Whoever stands on the Night of Decree, meeting it in faith and seeking reward, will be forgiven. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me; Shababah narrated to us; Warqa narrated to me, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: "Whoever stands in prayer on the Night of Decree and encounters it, as I think he said, with faith and seeking reward, will be forgiven."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لاَ يَجْعَلَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ جُزْءًا لاَ يَرَى إِلاَّ أَنَّ حَقًّا عَلَيْهِ أَنْ لاَ يَنْصَرِفَ إِلاَّ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ أَكْثَرُ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْصَرِفُ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ ‏.‏
before: Abdullah said: None of you should give Satan a share of himself by thinking that he must turn only to his right. Most often I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) turn to his left after prayer. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us; Abu Muawiyah and Waki narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Umarah, from al-Aswad, from Abdullah, who said: None of you should give Satan a share of himself by thinking that he must turn only to his right. Most often, I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) turn to his left.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ وَرْقَاءَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَلاَ صَلاَةَ إِلاَّ الْمَكْتُوبَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ وَابْنُ رَافِعٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ حَدَّثَنِي وَرْقَاءُ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
before: Abu Hurayra reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: When the prayer has been established, there is no prayer except the obligatory prayer. Muhammad ibn Hatim and Ibn Rafi narrated the same chain. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ahmad ibn Hanbal narrated to me; Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, from Warqa, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: "When the prayer is established, there is no prayer except the prescribed prayer." Muhammad ibn Hatim and Ibn Rafi narrated this to me; they said: Shababah narrated to us; Warqa narrated this to me with this chain.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، يَقُولُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَلاَ صَلاَةَ إِلاَّ الْمَكْتُوبَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Hurayra reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: When the prayer has been established, there is no prayer except the obligatory prayer. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Habib al-Harithi narrated to me; Ruh narrated to us; Zakariyya ibn Ishaq narrated to us; Amr ibn Dinar narrated to us, saying: I heard Ata ibn Yasar say, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), that he said: "When the prayer is established, there is no prayer except the prescribed prayer."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ هَلْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي وَهُوَ قَاعِدٌ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ بَعْدَ مَا حَطَمَهُ النَّاسُ ‏.‏
before: Aisha was asked whether the Prophet (peace be upon him) prayed sitting. She said: Yes, after people had worn him down. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us; Yazid ibn Zuray narrated to us; from Sa'id al-Jurayri, from Abdullah ibn Shaqiq, who said: I asked Aishah, "Did the Prophet (peace be upon him) pray while seated?" She said, "Yes, after people had worn him down."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا كَهْمَسٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
before: The narrators transmitted from Aisha a report with the same meaning from the Prophet (peace be upon him). The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ubaydullah ibn Muadh narrated to us; my father narrated to us; Kahmas narrated to us, from Abdullah ibn Shaqiq, who said: I said to Aishah. He then mentioned from the Prophet (peace be upon him) the like of it.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَيَّارٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
before: Yahya ibn Habib narrated from Shuba, from Sayyar, with this chain and the same wording. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Habib narrated this to me; Ruh ibn Ubadah narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us; Sayyar narrated to us, with this chain and the like of it.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَطَالَ الرَّجُلُ الْغَيْبَةَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ أَهْلَهُ طُرُوقًا ‏.‏
before: Jabir said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade a man who had been away for a long time from coming to his family suddenly at night. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us; Muhammad, meaning Ibn Ja'far, narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, from Asim, from al-Sha'bi, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade a man who had been away for a long time from coming to his family at night.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، - قَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، - عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي شَىْءٍ مِنَ النَّوَافِلِ أَسْرَعَ مِنْهُ إِلَى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: I never saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) hasten toward any voluntary prayer as he hastened toward the two units before Fajr. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Ibn Numayr narrated to us, both from Hafs ibn Ghiyath. Ibn Numayr said: Hafs narrated to us; from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata, from Ubayd ibn Umayr, from Aishah, who said: I never saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) hasten toward any voluntary prayer as he hastened toward the two units before dawn.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ رَكْعَتَا الْفَجْرِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: The two units of Fajr are better than the world and everything in it. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Ubayd al-Ghubari narrated to us; Abu Awanah narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Zurara ibn Awfa, from Sa'd ibn Hisham, from Aishah, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: "The two units before dawn are better than the world and all that is in it."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ حَسَنِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ سَمُرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَمُتْ حَتَّى صَلَّى قَاعِدًا ‏.‏
before: Jabir ibn Samurah reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) did not die until he prayed sitting. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us; Ubaydullah ibn Musa narrated to us, from Hasan ibn Salih, from Simak, who said: Jabir ibn Samurah informed me that the Prophet (peace be upon him) did not die until he had prayed while seated.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى بِالْمَدِينَةِ سَبْعًا وَثَمَانِيًا الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ وَالْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed seven and eight together in Medina: Zuhr and Asr, and Maghrib and Isha. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani narrated to us; Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Zayd, from Ibn Abbas, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed seven and eight in Medina: Zuhr and Asr, and Maghrib and Isha.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَنْصَرِفُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ ‏.‏
before: Anas reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) used to turn to his right after prayer. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Zuhayr ibn Harb said: Waki narrated to us, from Sufyan, from al-Suddi, from Anas, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) used to turn to his right.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ فَمُطِرْنَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لِيُصَلِّ مَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ فِي رَحْلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Jabir said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on a journey, and rain fell on us. He said: Let whoever among you wishes pray in his lodging. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us; Abu Khaythamah informed us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir. And Ahmad ibn Yunus narrated to us, saying: Zuhayr narrated to us; Abu al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jabir, who said: We went out on a journey with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and it rained. He said: "Let whoever among you wishes pray in his lodging."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ، صَاحِبُ الزِّيَادِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنُ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ يَوْمَ جُمُعَةٍ فِي يَوْمٍ مَطِيرٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ وَقَالَ وَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ تَمْشُوا فِي الدَّحْضِ وَالزَّلَلِ ‏.‏
before: Abdullah ibn al-Harith said: Ibn Abbas's caller gave the call to prayer on a Friday during rain. He mentioned something like Ibn Ulayyah's report and said: I disliked making you walk through slippery ground. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to me; Ibn Shumayl informed us; Shu'bah informed us; Abdul-Hamid, the companion of al-Ziyadi, narrated to us, saying: I heard Abdullah ibn al-Harith say: Ibn Abbas's caller to prayer gave the call on a Friday when it was raining. He mentioned a report like Ibn Ulayyah's and said: "I disliked that you should walk through mud and slippery ground."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ نَادَى بِالصَّلاَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ ذَاتِ بَرْدٍ وَرِيحٍ وَمَطَرٍ فَقَالَ فِي آخِرِ نِدَائِهِ أَلاَ صَلُّوا فِي رِحَالِكُمْ أَلاَ صَلُّوا فِي الرِّحَالِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْمُرُ الْمُؤَذِّنَ إِذَا كَانَتْ لَيْلَةٌ بَارِدَةٌ أَوْ ذَاتُ مَطَرٍ فِي السَّفَرِ أَنْ يَقُولَ أَلاَ صَلُّوا فِي رِحَالِكُمْ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar called the prayer on a cold, windy and rainy night. At the end of his call he said: Pray in your lodgings. He then said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to command the caller, when it was cold or rainy during travel, to say: Pray in your lodgings. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us; my father narrated to us; Ubaydullah narrated to us; Nafi narrated to me, from Ibn Umar, that he called people to prayer on a cold, windy, rainy night. At the end of his call he said: "Pray in your dwellings; pray in your dwellings." Then he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to command the caller, on a cold or rainy night while travelling, to say: "Pray in your dwellings."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ اشْتَرَى مِنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعِيرًا فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ آتِيَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَأُصَلِّيَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
before: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) bought a camel from me. When he reached Medina, he ordered me to go to the mosque and pray two units. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ubaydullah ibn Muadh narrated to us; my father narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, from Muharib, who heard Jabir ibn Abdullah say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) bought a camel from me. When he arrived in Medina, he ordered me to come to the mosque and pray two units.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، وَابْنُ، خَشْرَمٍ قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
before: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Abu Kurayb, Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah, Ishaq and Ibn Khushram narrated to us, all from al-Amash, with this chain and similar wording. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb said: Abu Muawiyah narrated to us. And Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, saying: Jarir narrated to us. And Ishaq and Ibn Khushram said: Isa informed us. All of them narrated from al-A'mash with this chain, something like it.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَمَرَ مُؤَذِّنَهُ - فِي حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ - فِي يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ فِي يَوْمٍ مَطِيرٍ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَذَكَرَ فِي حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ فَعَلَهُ مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنِّي ‏.‏ يَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas ordered his caller, on a Friday and a rainy day, with the meaning of their report. In Ma'mar's narration he mentioned: One better than me did this, meaning the Prophet (peace be upon him). The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abd ibn Humayd narrated this to us; Sa'id ibn Amir narrated to us, from Shu'bah. And Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us; Abd al-Razzaq informed us; Ma'mar informed us. Both narrated from Asim al-Ahwal, from Abdullah ibn al-Harith, that Ibn Abbas instructed his caller to prayer on a Friday when it was raining, with wording like their reports. In Ma'mar's report, he mentioned: "One better than me did this," meaning the Prophet (peace be upon him).

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الْحَضْرَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، - قَالَ وُهَيْبٌ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهُ مِنْهُ - قَالَ أَمَرَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ مُؤَذِّنَهُ فِي يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ فِي يَوْمٍ مَطِيرٍ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas ordered his caller to prayer on a Friday during rain with wording like the reports of the others. Wuhayb said that he had not heard this directly from Abdullah ibn al-Harith. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abd ibn Humayd narrated this to us; Ahmad ibn Ishaq al-Hadrami narrated to us; Wuhayb narrated to us; Ayyub narrated to us, from Abdullah ibn al-Harith. Wuhayb said: He did not hear it from him. He said: Ibn Abbas instructed his caller to prayer on a Friday when it was raining, with wording like their report.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي سُبْحَتَهُ حَيْثُمَا تَوَجَّهَتْ بِهِ نَاقَتُهُ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to offer his voluntary prayer wherever his riding camel turned. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us; my father narrated to us; Ubaydullah narrated to us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to offer his voluntary prayer wherever his riding camel turned.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ حَيْثُ تَوَجَّهَتْ بِهِ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) used to pray on his riding animal wherever it turned. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated this to us; Abu Khalid al-Ahmar narrated to us, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) used to pray on his riding animal wherever it faced.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي وَهُوَ مُقْبِلٌ مِنْ مَكَّةَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ حَيْثُ كَانَ وَجْهُهُ - قَالَ - وَفِيهِ نَزَلَتْ ‏[quran sura="2" aya_start="115" aya_end="115"]{‏ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ اللَّهِ‏}‏
before: Ibn Umar said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed while travelling from Mecca to Medina on his riding animal, wherever its face was directed. It was revealed about this: Wherever you turn, there is the Face of Allah (Quran 2:115, verse 115). The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ubaydullah ibn Umar al-Qawariri narrated to me; Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Abd al-Malik ibn Abi Sulayman, who said: Sa'id ibn Jubayr narrated to us, from Ibn Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to pray while travelling from Mecca to Medina on his riding animal, wherever it faced. He said: It was concerning this that the following was revealed: "Wherever you turn, there is the Face of Allah" (Quran 2:115).

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، وَابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي كُلُّهُمْ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ مُبَارَكٍ وَابْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ ثُمَّ تَلاَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ [quran sura="2" aya_start="115" aya_end="115"]‏{‏ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ اللَّهِ‏}‏ وَقَالَ فِي هَذَا نَزَلَتْ ‏.‏
before: Ibn al-Mubarak and Ibn Abi Za'idah narrated this chain. Ibn Umar then recited: Wherever you turn, there is the Face of Allah (Quran 2:115, verse 115), and said: This was revealed concerning this. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Kurayb narrated this to us; Ibn al-Mubarak and Ibn Abi Za'idah informed us. And Ibn Numayr narrated to us; my father narrated to us. All of them narrated from Abd al-Malik with this chain, something like it. In the report of Ibn al-Mubarak and Ibn Abi Za'idah, Ibn Umar then recited: "Wherever you turn, there is the Face of Allah" (Quran 2:115), and said: "It was concerning this that it was revealed."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى الْمَازِنِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي عَلَى حِمَارٍ وَهُوَ مُوَجِّهٌ إِلَى خَيْبَرَ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) praying on a donkey while facing Khaybar. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, saying: I read to Malik, from Amr ibn Yahya al-Mazini, from Sa'id ibn Yasar, from Ibn Umar, who said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) praying on a donkey, facing Khaybar.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ حَيْثُمَا تَوَجَّهَتْ بِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to pray on his riding animal wherever it turned. Abdullah ibn Dinar said: Ibn Umar used to do that. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, saying: I read to Malik, from Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to pray on his riding animal wherever it faced him. Abdullah ibn Dinar said: Ibn Umar used to do that.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي عِيسَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ الْهَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُوتِرُ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to perform witr on his riding animal. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Isa ibn Hammad al-Misri narrated to me; al-Layth informed us; Ibn al-Had narrated to me, from Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Abdullah ibn Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to perform witr on his riding animal.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي السُّبْحَةَ بِاللَّيْلِ فِي السَّفَرِ عَلَى ظَهْرِ رَاحِلَتِهِ حَيْثُ تَوَجَّهَتْ ‏.‏
before: Abdullah ibn Amir ibn Rabiah reported from his father that he saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) praying the voluntary night prayer while travelling on the back of his riding animal, wherever it turned. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Amr ibn Sawwad and Harmalah said: Ibn Wahb informed us; Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Abdullah ibn Amir ibn Rabiah, who informed him that his father informed him that he saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) offering the voluntary prayer at night while travelling, on the back of his riding animal, wherever it faced.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا عَجِلَ بِهِ السَّيْرُ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar said: When the journey pressed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), he combined Maghrib and Isha prayers. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, saying: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, who said: When travel hurried the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), he combined Maghrib and Isha.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَعْجَلَهُ السَّيْرُ فِي السَّفَرِ يُؤَخِّرُ صَلاَةَ الْمَغْرِبِ حَتَّى يَجْمَعَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ صَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ ‏.‏
before: Salim ibn Abdullah reported from his father that he saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), when travel hurried him, delay Maghrib during a journey until he combined it with Isha. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me; Ibn Wahb informed us; Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Salim ibn Abdullah informed me that his father said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), when travel hurried him on a journey, delay the Maghrib prayer until he combined it with the Isha prayer.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed Maghrib and Isha together at al-Muzdalifah. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, saying: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed Maghrib and Isha together at al-Muzdalifah.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ الْمَدَايِنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عُقَيْلِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَجْمَعَ بَيْنَ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ فِي السَّفَرِ أَخَّرَ الظُّهْرَ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ أَوَّلُ وَقْتِ الْعَصْرِ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَهُمَا ‏.‏
before: Anas said: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) wished to combine two prayers during travel, he delayed Zuhr until the beginning of Asr time and then combined them. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Amr al-Naqid narrated to me; Shababah ibn Sawwar al-Mada'ini narrated to us; Layth ibn Sa'd narrated to us, from Uqayl ibn Khalid, from al-Zuhri, from Anas, who said: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) wished to combine two prayers while travelling, he delayed Zuhr until the beginning of Asr time, then combined them.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا عَجِلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّفَرُ يُؤَخِّرُ الظُّهْرَ إِلَى أَوَّلِ وَقْتِ الْعَصْرِ فَيَجْمَعُ بَيْنَهُمَا وَيُؤَخِّرُ الْمَغْرِبَ حَتَّى يَجْمَعَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ الْعِشَاءِ حِينَ يَغِيبُ الشَّفَقُ ‏.‏
before: Anas reported from the Prophet (peace be upon him): When travel hurried him, he delayed Zuhr until the beginning of Asr and combined them, and he delayed Maghrib until he combined it with Isha when the twilight disappeared. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu al-Tahir and Amr ibn Sawwad said: Ibn Wahb informed us; Jabir ibn Isma'il narrated to me, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, from Anas, from the Prophet (peace be upon him): When travel hurried him, he delayed Zuhr until the beginning of Asr time, combined them, and delayed Maghrib until he combined it with Isha when the twilight disappeared.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ جَمِيعًا وَالْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ جَمِيعًا فِي غَيْرِ خَوْفٍ وَلاَ سَفَرٍ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed Zuhr and Asr together, and Maghrib and Isha together, without fear and without travel. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, saying: I read to Malik, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed Zuhr and Asr together, and Maghrib and Isha together, without fear or travel.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَعَوْنُ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ زُهَيْرٍ، - قَالَ ابْنُ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ جَمِيعًا بِالْمَدِينَةِ فِي غَيْرِ خَوْفٍ وَلاَ سَفَرٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ فَسَأَلْتُ سَعِيدًا لِمَ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ كَمَا سَأَلْتَنِي فَقَالَ أَرَادَ أَنْ لاَ يُحْرِجَ أَحَدًا مِنْ أُمَّتِهِ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed Zuhr and Asr together in Medina without fear and without travel. Abu al-Zubayr asked Said why he did that. He said: I asked Ibn Abbas as you asked me, and he said: He wanted not to burden anyone from his community. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ahmad ibn Yunus and Awn ibn Sallam narrated to us, both from Zuhayr. Ibn Yunus said: Zuhayr narrated to us; Abu al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed Zuhr and Asr together in Medina, without fear or travel. Abu al-Zubayr said: I asked Sa'id why he had done that. He said: I asked Ibn Abbas as you asked me, and he said: He intended not to cause hardship for anyone in his community.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الصَّلاَةِ فِي سَفْرَةٍ سَافَرَهَا فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ فَجَمَعَ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَعِيدٌ فَقُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ مَا حَمَلَهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ قَالَ أَرَادَ أَنْ لاَ يُحْرِجَ أُمَّتَهُ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) combined the prayers during a journey he made in the campaign of Tabuk, combining Zuhr with Asr and Maghrib with Isha. Said asked Ibn Abbas what led him to do that, and he said: He wanted not to burden his community. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Habib al-Harithi narrated to us; Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, narrated to us; Qurrah narrated to us; Abu al-Zubayr narrated to us; Sa'id ibn Jubayr narrated to us; Ibn Abbas narrated to us, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) combined the prayers on a journey he made during the campaign of Tabuk, combining Zuhr with Asr and Maghrib with Isha. Sa'id said: I asked Ibn Abbas what led him to do that. He said: He intended not to cause hardship for his community.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ جَمَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فِي غَيْرِ خَوْفٍ وَلاَ مَطَرٍ ‏.‏ فِي حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ لِمَ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ كَىْ لاَ يُحْرِجَ أُمَّتَهُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ قِيلَ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ مَا أَرَادَ إِلَى ذَلِكَ قَالَ أَرَادَ أَنْ لاَ يُحْرِجَ أُمَّتَهُ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) combined Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha in Medina without fear and without rain. In Waki's narration I asked Ibn Abbas why he did that, and he said: So that he would not burden his community. In Abu Muawiyah's narration he was asked what he intended, and he gave the same answer. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb said: Abu Muawiyah narrated to us. And Abu Kurayb and Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj said, and the wording is Abu Kurayb's: Waki narrated to us. Both narrated from al-A'mash, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) combined Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha in Medina without fear or rain. In Waki's narration, I said to Ibn Abbas: Why did he do that? He said: So that he would not cause hardship for his community. In Abu Muawiyah's narration, Ibn Abbas was asked what he intended by that. He said: He intended not to cause hardship for his community.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَمَانِيًا جَمِيعًا وَسَبْعًا جَمِيعًا ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا أَبَا الشَّعْثَاءِ أَظُنُّهُ أَخَّرَ الظُّهْرَ وَعَجَّلَ الْعَصْرَ وَأَخَّرَ الْمَغْرِبَ وَعَجَّلَ الْعِشَاءَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَنَا أَظُنُّ ذَاكَ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas said: I prayed with the Prophet (peace be upon him) eight units together and seven units together. I said to Abu al-Shatha: I think he delayed Zuhr and hastened Asr, and delayed Maghrib and hastened Isha. He said: I think the same. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us; Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Amr, from Jabir ibn Zayd, from Ibn Abbas, who said: I prayed with the Prophet (peace be upon him) eight together and seven together. I said: Abu al-Sha'tha, I think he delayed Zuhr and brought Asr forward, and delayed Maghrib and brought Isha forward. He said: I think that too.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، عَامِرٍ عَنْ مُعَاذٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ فَكَانَ يُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ جَمِيعًا وَالْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
before: Muadh said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on the campaign of Tabuk. He used to combine Zuhr with Asr and Maghrib with Isha. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus narrated to us; Zuhayr narrated to us; Abu al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Abu al-Tufayl Amir, from Muadh, who said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on the campaign of Tabuk. He used to pray Zuhr and Asr together, and Maghrib and Isha together.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَامِرُ بْنُ وَاثِلَةَ أَبُو الطُّفَيْلِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ، قَالَ جَمَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ وَبَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ مَا حَمَلَهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَرَادَ أَنْ لاَ يُحْرِجَ أُمَّتَهُ ‏.‏
before: Muadh ibn Jabal said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) combined Zuhr and Asr, and Maghrib and Isha, during the campaign of Tabuk. I asked what led him to do that, and he said: He wanted not to burden his community. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Habib narrated to us; Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, narrated to us; Qurrah ibn Khalid narrated to us; Abu al-Zubayr narrated to us; Amir ibn Wathilah, Abu al-Tufayl, narrated to us; Muadh ibn Jabal narrated to us, saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) combined Zuhr and Asr, and Maghrib and Isha, during the campaign of Tabuk. I said: What led him to do that? He said: He intended not to cause hardship for his community.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْبَكْرَاوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَرْجِسَ، قَالَ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ الْمَسْجِدَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي صَلاَةِ الْغَدَاةِ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي جَانِبِ الْمَسْجِدِ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا فُلاَنُ بِأَىِّ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ اعْتَدَدْتَ أَبِصَلاَتِكَ وَحْدَكَ أَمْ بِصَلاَتِكَ مَعَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abdullah ibn Sarjis said: A man entered the mosque while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was praying the morning prayer. He prayed two units at the side of the mosque, then joined the Messenger of Allah. When the Messenger of Allah completed the prayer, he said: O so-and-so, which of the two prayers did you count: your prayer alone or your prayer with us? The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the exact circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Kamil al-Jahdari narrated to us; Hammad, meaning Ibn Zayd, narrated to us. And Hamid ibn Umar al-Bakrawi narrated to me; Abd al-Wahid, meaning Ibn Ziyad, narrated to us. And Ibn Numayr narrated to us; Abu Muawiyah narrated to us. All of them narrated from Asim. And Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me, and his is the wording: Marwan ibn Muawiyah al-Fazari narrated to us, from Asim al-Ahwal, from Abdullah ibn Sarjis, who said: A man entered the mosque while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was performing the dawn prayer. He prayed two units at the side of the mosque, then joined the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). When the Messenger of Allah had finished with the salutation, he said: "So-and-so, which of the two prayers did you count: your prayer by yourself or your prayer with us?"

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Qatadah reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: When one of you enters the mosque, let him pray two units before sitting. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id said: Malik narrated to us. And Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, saying: I read to Malik, from Amir ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr, from Amr ibn Sulaym al-Zuraqi, from Abu Qatadah, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "When one of you enters the mosque, let him pray two units before sitting down."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمِ بْنِ خَلْدَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، صَاحِبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ دَخَلْتُ الْمَسْجِدَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسٌ بَيْنَ ظَهْرَانَىِ النَّاسِ - قَالَ - فَجَلَسْتُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَرْكَعَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَجْلِسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ رَأَيْتُكَ جَالِسًا وَالنَّاسُ جُلُوسٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلاَ يَجْلِسْ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Qatadah entered the mosque while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was sitting among the people. He sat, and the Messenger of Allah said: What prevented you from praying two units before sitting? He replied: I saw you sitting and the people sitting. The Prophet said: When one of you enters the mosque, let him not sit until he has prayed two units. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us; Husayn ibn Ali narrated to us, from Za'idah. He said: Amr ibn Yahya al-Ansari narrated to me; Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban narrated to me, from Amr ibn Sulaym ibn Khaldah al-Ansari, from Abu Qatadah, the Companion of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), who said: I entered the mosque while the Messenger of Allah was sitting among the people, and I sat down. The Messenger of Allah said: "What prevented you from praying two units before sitting?" I said: Messenger of Allah, I saw you sitting and the people sitting. He said: "When one of you enters the mosque, let him not sit until he has prayed two units."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ جَوَّاسٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ الأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ لِي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَيْنٌ فَقَضَانِي وَزَادَنِي وَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ الْمَسْجِدَ فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ صَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Jabir said: I owed the Prophet (peace be upon him) a debt. He paid me and added to it. I entered the mosque, and he said to me: Pray two units. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ahmad ibn Jawwas al-Hanafi, Abu Asim, narrated to us; Ubaydullah al-Ashja'i narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Muharib ibn Dithar, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, who said: I had a debt owed to me by the Prophet (peace be upon him). He paid it back to me and gave me more. I entered the mosque, and he said to me: "Pray two units."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالاَ، جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِكَرَاهَةِ الطُّرُوقِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ يَتَخَوَّنُهُمْ أَوْ يَلْتَمِسُ عَثَرَاتِهِمْ ‏.‏
before: The Prophet (peace be upon him) disliked a man returning to his family at night from a journey, suspecting them or seeking their faults. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us; Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us. And Ubaydullah ibn Muadh narrated to us; my father narrated to us. Both said: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Muharib, from Jabir, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), concerning the dislike of arriving at night, but he did not mention: "suspecting them of betrayal or seeking their faults."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَطْرُقَ الرَّجُلُ أَهْلَهُ لَيْلاً يَتَخَوَّنُهُمْ أَوْ يَلْتَمِسُ عَثَرَاتِهِمْ ‏.‏
before: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade a man from coming to his family at night, suspecting them or seeking their faults. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us; Waki narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Muharib, from Jabir, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade a man from coming to his family at night, suspecting them of betrayal or seeking their faults.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي الثَّقَفِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزَاةٍ فَأَبْطَأَ بِي جَمَلِي وَأَعْيَى ثُمَّ قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبْلِي وَقَدِمْتُ بِالْغَدَاةِ فَجِئْتُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَوَجَدْتُهُ عَلَى بَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الآنَ حِينَ قَدِمْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَدَعْ جَمَلَكَ وَادْخُلْ فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَخَلْتُ فَصَلَّيْتُ ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ ‏.‏
before: Jabir went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on an expedition. His camel became slow and tired. The Messenger of Allah arrived before him, told him to leave the camel and enter the mosque to pray two units, and Jabir did so. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to me; Abd al-Wahhab, meaning al-Thaqafi, narrated to us; Ubaydullah narrated to us, from Wahb ibn Kaysan, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, who said: I went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on an expedition. My camel lagged behind me and became exhausted. Then the Messenger of Allah arrived ahead of me. I arrived in the morning and came to the mosque, where I found him at the mosque's entrance. He said: "Is this when you have arrived?" I said: Yes. He said: "Leave your camel, enter, and pray two units." I entered and prayed, then returned.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ تَزَوَّجْتُ امْرَأَةً فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَقِيتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا جَابِرُ تَزَوَّجْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِكْرٌ أَمْ ثَيِّبٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثَيِّبٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلاَّ بِكْرًا تُلاَعِبُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ لِي أَخَوَاتٍ فَخَشِيتُ أَنْ تَدْخُلَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُنَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَذَاكَ إِذًا ‏.‏ إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ تُنْكَحُ عَلَى دِينِهَا وَمَالِهَا وَجَمَالِهَا فَعَلَيْكَ بِذَاتِ الدِّينِ تَرِبَتْ يَدَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Jabir married a previously married woman. The Prophet (peace be upon him) asked whether she was a virgin or previously married, and advised him that a young woman would play with him. Jabir explained that he had young sisters and wanted a wife who would care for and improve them. The Prophet said: You have done well. The woman is sought for her religion, wealth and beauty, so choose the one of religion. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us; my father narrated to us; Abd al-Malik ibn Abi Sulayman narrated to us, from Ata, who informed me: Jabir ibn Abdullah said: I married a woman during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). I met the Prophet and he said: "Jabir, have you married?" I said: Yes. He said: "A virgin or a previously married woman?" I said: A previously married woman. He said: "Why not a virgin, so you could play with her?" I said: Messenger of Allah, I have sisters, and I feared she might come between me and them. He said: "That is the reason, then. A woman is married for her religion, her wealth and her beauty. So seek the one with religion; may your hands be rubbed with dust."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، هَلَكَ وَتَرَكَ تِسْعَ بَنَاتٍ - أَوْ قَالَ سَبْعَ - فَتَزَوَّجْتُ امْرَأَةً ثَيِّبًا فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا جَابِرُ تَزَوَّجْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَبِكْرٌ أَمْ ثَيِّبٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ بَلْ ثَيِّبٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلاَّ جَارِيَةً تُلاَعِبُهَا وَتُلاَعِبُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ تُضَاحِكُهَا وَتُضَاحِكُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ هَلَكَ وَتَرَكَ تِسْعَ بَنَاتٍ - أَوْ سَبْعَ - وَإِنِّي كَرِهْتُ أَنْ آتِيَهُنَّ أَوْ أَجِيئَهُنَّ بِمِثْلِهِنَّ فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أَجِيءَ بِامْرَأَةٍ تَقُومُ عَلَيْهِنَّ وَتُصْلِحُهُنَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ لِي خَيْرًا وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي الرَّبِيعِ ‏"‏ تُلاَعِبُهَا وَتُلاَعِبُكَ وَتُضَاحِكُهَا وَتُضَاحِكُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abdullah died leaving nine daughters, or seven. Jabir married a previously married woman. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) asked why he had not married a young woman. Jabir explained that he wanted a wife to care for and discipline his sisters. The Prophet prayed that Allah bless him and spoke well of his choice. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya and Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani narrated to us. Yahya said: Hammad ibn Zayd informed us, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, that Abdullah died leaving nine daughters, or he said seven, and I married a previously married woman. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to me: "Jabir, have you married?" I said: Yes. He said: "A virgin or a previously married woman?" I said: Rather, a previously married woman, Messenger of Allah. He said: "Why not a young woman with whom you could play and who could play with you?" Or he said: "who would make you laugh and whom you would make laugh?" I said: Abdullah died leaving nine daughters, or seven, and I disliked bringing them someone like them. I wanted to bring a woman who would take care of them and set them right. He said: "May Allah bless you." Or he said something good to me. Abu al-Rabi's narration says: "with whom you could play and who could play with you, and who would make you laugh and whom you would make laugh."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزَاةٍ فَلَمَّا أَقْبَلْنَا تَعَجَّلْتُ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ لِي قَطُوفٍ فَلَحِقَنِي رَاكِبٌ خَلْفِي فَنَخَسَ بَعِيرِي بِعَنَزَةٍ كَانَتْ مَعَهُ فَانْطَلَقَ بَعِيرِي كَأَجْوَدِ مَا أَنْتَ رَاءٍ مِنَ الإِبِلِ فَالْتَفَتُّ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا يُعْجِلُكَ يَا جَابِرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي حَدِيثُ عَهْدٍ بِعُرْسٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَبِكْرًا تَزَوَّجْتَهَا أَمْ ثَيِّبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ بَلْ ثَيِّبًا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلاَّ جَارِيَةً تُلاَعِبُهَا وَتُلاَعِبُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ ذَهَبْنَا لِنَدْخُلَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْهِلُوا حَتَّى نَدْخُلَ لَيْلاً - أَىْ عِشَاءً - كَىْ تَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ وَتَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا قَدِمْتَ فَالْكَيْسَ الْكَيْسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Jabir travelled with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on an expedition. On the return journey he hurried his tired camel. The Prophet asked about his marriage, advised him about marrying a young woman, and when they reached Medina told the people to wait until night so that the unkempt woman could comb her hair and the absent wife could groom herself. He said: When you arrive, act wisely and carefully. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us; Hushaym informed us, from Sayyar, from al-Sha'bi, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, who said: We were with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on an expedition. As we returned, I hurried ahead on a slow camel of mine. A rider behind me caught up and prodded my camel with a short spear he had with him. My camel then went as well as the finest camel you could see. I turned and found the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). He said: "What is making you hurry, Jabir?" I said: Messenger of Allah, I have only recently married. He said: "Did you marry a virgin or a previously married woman?" I said: Rather, a previously married woman. He said: "Why not a young woman with whom you could play and who could play with you?" When we reached Medina and were about to enter, he said: "Wait until we enter at night, meaning after Isha, so that the woman with dishevelled hair may comb herself and the woman whose husband has been away may groom herself." He also said: "When you arrive, act wisely and carefully."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ الثَّقَفِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزَاةٍ فَأَبْطَأَ بِي جَمَلِي فَأَتَى عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ يَا جَابِرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا شَأْنُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَبْطَأَ بِي جَمَلِي وَأَعْيَا فَتَخَلَّفْتُ ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَ فَحَجَنَهُ بِمِحْجَنِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَكِبْتُ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي أَكُفُّهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَزَوَّجْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَبِكْرًا أَمْ ثَيِّبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ بَلْ ثَيِّبٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلاَّ جَارِيَةً تُلاَعِبُهَا وَتُلاَعِبُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ إِنَّ لِي أَخَوَاتٍ فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أَتَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً تَجْمَعُهُنَّ وَتَمْشُطُهُنَّ وَتَقُومُ عَلَيْهِنَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا إِنَّكَ قَادِمٌ فَإِذَا قَدِمْتَ فَالْكَيْسَ الْكَيْسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَبِيعُ جَمَلَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَاشْتَرَاهُ مِنِّي بِأُوقِيَّةٍ ثُمَّ قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدِمْتُ بِالْغَدَاةِ فَجِئْتُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَوَجَدْتُهُ عَلَى بَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ الآنَ حِينَ قَدِمْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَدَعْ جَمَلَكَ وَادْخُلْ فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَخَلْتُ فَصَلَّيْتُ ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ فَأَمَرَ بِلاَلاً أَنْ يَزِنَ لِي أُوقِيَّةً فَوَزَنَ لِي بِلاَلٌ فَأَرْجَحَ فِي الْمِيزَانِ - قَالَ - فَانْطَلَقْتُ فَلَمَّا وَلَّيْتُ قَالَ ‏"‏ ادْعُ لِي جَابِرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَدُعِيتُ فَقُلْتُ الآنَ يَرُدُّ عَلَىَّ الْجَمَلَ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ شَىْءٌ أَبْغَضَ إِلَىَّ مِنْهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ خُذْ جَمَلَكَ وَلَكَ ثَمَنُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

He ordered him to pray two units when he arrived in Medina, and ordered Bilal to weigh the payment, adding to the measure. Then he told Jabir to take the camel and its price. after: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us; Abd al-Wahhab, meaning Ibn Abd al-Majid al-Thaqafi, narrated to us; Ubaydullah narrated to us, from Wahb ibn Kaysan, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, who said: I went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on an expedition. My camel slowed me down, so the Messenger of Allah came up to me and said: "Jabir?" I said: Yes. He said: "What is the matter with you?" I said: My camel has slowed me down and is exhausted, so I have fallen behind. He dismounted and bent its leg with his crook, then said: "Ride." I rode, and I found myself having to hold it back from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). He said: "Have you married?" I said: Yes. He said: "A virgin or a previously married woman?" I said: Rather, a previously married woman. He said: "Why not a young woman with whom you could play and who could play with you?" I said: I have sisters, and I wanted to marry a woman who would gather them together, comb their hair and take care of them. He said: "You are about to arrive, so act wisely and carefully when you do." Then he said: "Will you sell your camel?" I said: Yes. He bought it from me for an uqiyyah. Then the Messenger of Allah arrived, and I arrived in the morning. I came to the mosque and found him at its entrance. He said: "Is this when you have arrived?" I said: Yes. He said: "Leave your camel, enter and pray two units." I entered and prayed, then returned. He ordered Bilal to weigh an uqiyyah for me. Bilal weighed it for me and gave extra on the scale. I left, but when I had turned away he said: "Call Jabir to me." I was called, and I thought: Now he is going to return my camel to me, and nothing was more hateful to me than it. He said: "Take your camel, and its price is yours."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا فِي مَسِيرٍ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا عَلَى نَاضِحٍ إِنَّمَا هُوَ فِي أُخْرَيَاتِ النَّاسِ - قَالَ - فَضَرَبَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ قَالَ نَخَسَهُ - أُرَاهُ قَالَ - بِشَىْءٍ كَانَ مَعَهُ قَالَ فَجَعَلَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يَتَقَدَّمُ النَّاسَ يُنَازِعُنِي حَتَّى إِنِّي لأَكُفُّهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَتَبِيعُنِيهِ بِكَذَا وَكَذَا وَاللَّهُ يَغْفِرُ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ هُوَ لَكَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَبِيعُنِيهِ بِكَذَا وَكَذَا وَاللَّهُ يَغْفِرُ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ هُوَ لَكَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ أَتَزَوَّجْتَ بَعْدَ أَبِيكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثَيِّبًا أَمْ بِكْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ ثَيِّبًا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلاَّ تَزَوَّجْتَ بِكْرًا تُضَاحِكُكَ وَتُضَاحِكُهَا وَتُلاَعِبُكَ وَتُلاَعِبُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو نَضْرَةَ فَكَانَتْ كَلِمَةً يَقُولُهَا الْمُسْلِمُونَ ‏.‏ افْعَلْ كَذَا وَكَذَا وَاللَّهُ يَغْفِرُ لَكَ ‏.‏

after: Muhammad ibn Abd al-A'la narrated to us; al-Mu'tamir narrated to us, saying: I heard my father. Abu Nadrah narrated to us, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, who said: We were travelling with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and I was on a water-carrying camel near the rear of the people. The Messenger of Allah struck it, or, I think he said, prodded it with something he had with him. After that it began to get ahead of the people and jostle me, until I had to restrain it. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "Will you sell it to me for such-and-such, and may Allah forgive you?" I said: It is yours, Prophet of Allah. He said again: "Will you sell it to me for such-and-such, and may Allah forgive you?" I said: It is yours, Prophet of Allah. He then said to me: "Did you marry after your father?" I said: Yes. He said: "A previously married woman or a virgin?" I said: A previously married woman. He said: "Why did you not marry a virgin, so that you would make each other laugh and play with one another?" Abu Nadrah said: This was a phrase the Muslims used to say: "Do such-and-such, and may Allah forgive you."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ أَقْبَلْنَا مِنْ مَكَّةَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاعْتَلَّ جَمَلِي ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِقِصَّتِهِ وَفِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي ‏"‏ بِعْنِي جَمَلَكَ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ بَلْ هُوَ لَكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ بَلْ بِعْنِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ بَلْ هُوَ لَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ بَلْ بِعْنِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّ لِرَجُلٍ عَلَىَّ أُوقِيَّةَ ذَهَبٍ فَهُوَ لَكَ بِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ أَخَذْتُهُ فَتَبَلَّغْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِبِلاَلٍ ‏"‏ أَعْطِهِ أُوقِيَّةً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَزِدْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَعْطَانِي أُوقِيَّةً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَزَادَنِي قِيرَاطًا - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ لاَ تُفَارِقُنِي زِيَادَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - فَكَانَ فِي كِيسٍ لِي فَأَخَذَهُ أَهْلُ الشَّامِ يَوْمَ الْحَرَّةِ ‏.‏

after: Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us; Jarir narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Jabir, who said: We were returning from Mecca to Medina with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and my camel became ill. He related the story. In it, he then said to me: "Sell me this camel of yours." I said: No, rather it is yours. He said: "No, sell it to me." I said: No, rather it is yours, Messenger of Allah. He said: "No, sell it to me." I said: A man is owed an uqiyyah of gold by me, so it is yours for that amount. He said: "I have accepted it. Ride it until you reach Medina." When I arrived in Medina, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to Bilal: "Give him an uqiyyah of gold and add to it." Bilal gave me an uqiyyah of gold and added a qirat. I said: The Messenger of Allah's extra gift will never leave me. It was in a pouch of mine, and the people of Syria took it on the Day of al-Harrah.

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي شُرَحْبِيلُ بْنُ شَرِيكٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيَّ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الدُّنْيَا مَتَاعٌ وَخَيْرُ مَتَاعِ الدُّنْيَا الْمَرْأَةُ الصَّالِحَةُ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A woman is like a rib. If you try to straighten her, you will break her, but if you leave her, you will enjoy her while she has some crookedness. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Numayr al-Hamdani narrated to me; Abdullah ibn Yazid narrated to us; Haywah narrated to us; Shurahbil ibn Sharik informed me that he heard Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Hubuli narrating from Abdullah ibn Amr, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "The world is provision, and the best provision of the world is a righteous woman."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَسِيرُ عَلَى جَمَلٍ لَهُ قَدْ أَعْيَا فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يُسَيِّبَهُ قَالَ فَلَحِقَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَا لِي وَضَرَبَهُ فَسَارَ سَيْرًا لَمْ يَسِرْ مِثْلَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِعْنِيهِ بِوُقِيَّةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لاَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِعْنِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَبِعْتُهُ بِوُقِيَّةٍ وَاسْتَثْنَيْتُ عَلَيْهِ حُمْلاَنَهُ إِلَى أَهْلِي فَلَمَّا بَلَغْتُ أَتَيْتُهُ بِالْجَمَلِ فَنَقَدَنِي ثَمَنَهُ ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ فَأَرْسَلَ فِي أَثَرِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتُرَانِي مَاكَسْتُكَ لآخُذَ جَمَلَكَ خُذْ جَمَلَكَ وَدَرَاهِمَكَ فَهُوَ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

after: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us; my father narrated to us; Zakariyya narrated to us, from Amir, who narrated to me: Jabir ibn Abdullah was riding a camel of his that had become exhausted, and he wanted to let it go. The Prophet (peace be upon him) caught up with me, supplicated for me and struck it, and it went as it had never gone before. He said: "Sell it to me for an uqiyyah." I said: No. Then he said: "Sell it to me." So I sold it to him for an uqiyyah, stipulating that I could ride it to my family. When I arrived, I brought him the camel and he paid me its price in full. Then I went back. He sent someone after me and said: "Did you think I bargained with you in order to take your camel? Take your camel and your dirhams; it is yours."

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَيَّارٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزَاةٍ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ ذَهَبْنَا لِنَدْخُلَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْهِلُوا حَتَّى نَدْخُلَ لَيْلاً - أَىْ عِشَاءً - كَىْ تَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ وَتَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Jabir said: We were with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on an expedition. When we reached Medina and wanted to enter, he said: Wait until we enter at night, meaning after Isha, so that the woman with unkempt hair may comb herself and the absent wife may groom herself. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ismail ibn Salim narrated to me; Hushaym narrated to us; Sayyar informed us. And Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, and this is his wording: Hushaym narrated to us, from Sayyar, from al-Sha'bi, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, who said: We were with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on an expedition. When we reached Medina and were about to enter, he said: "Wait until we enter at night, meaning after Isha, so that the woman with dishevelled hair may comb herself and the woman whose husband has been away may groom herself."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعُثْمَانَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ غَزَوْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَلاَحَقَ بِي وَتَحْتِي نَاضِحٌ لِي قَدْ أَعْيَا وَلاَ يَكَادُ يَسِيرُ قَالَ فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ مَا لِبَعِيرِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ عَلِيلٌ - قَالَ - فَتَخَلَّفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَزَجَرَهُ وَدَعَا لَهُ فَمَازَالَ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ الإِبِلِ قُدَّامَهَا يَسِيرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ كَيْفَ تَرَى بَعِيرَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ بِخَيْرٍ قَدْ أَصَابَتْهُ بَرَكَتُكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَتَبِيعُنِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَنَا نَاضِحٌ غَيْرُهُ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَبِعْتُهُ إِيَّاهُ عَلَى أَنَّ لِي فَقَارَ ظَهْرِهِ حَتَّى أَبْلُغَ الْمَدِينَةَ - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي عَرُوسٌ فَاسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ فَأَذِنَ لِي فَتَقَدَّمْتُ النَّاسَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ حَتَّى انْتَهَيْتُ فَلَقِيَنِي خَالِي فَسَأَلَنِي عَنِ الْبَعِيرِ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِمَا صَنَعْتُ فِيهِ فَلاَمَنِي فِيهِ - قَالَ - وَقَدْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِي حِينَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ ‏"‏ مَا تَزَوَّجْتَ أَبِكْرًا أَمْ ثَيِّبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ تَزَوَّجْتُ ثَيِّبًا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَلاَ تَزَوَّجْتَ بِكْرًا تُلاَعِبُكَ وَتُلاَعِبُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تُوُفِّيَ وَالِدِي - أَوِ اسْتُشْهِدَ - وَلِي أَخَوَاتٌ صِغَارٌ فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أَتَزَوَّجَ إِلَيْهِنَّ مِثْلَهُنَّ فَلاَ تُؤَدِّبُهُنَّ وَلاَ تَقُومُ عَلَيْهِنَّ فَتَزَوَّجْتُ ثَيِّبًا لِتَقُومَ عَلَيْهِنَّ وَتُؤَدِّبَهُنَّ - قَالَ - فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ غَدَوْتُ إِلَيْهِ بِالْبَعِيرِ فَأَعْطَانِي ثَمَنَهُ وَرَدَّهُ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏
before: Jabir reported a shortened version of the camel story. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) bought the camel, paid an uqiyyah of gold and added a qirat. Jabir said he kept the Prophet's addition, but it was later taken from his bag by the people of Syria on the day of al-Harrah. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. after: Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, and this is Uthman's wording. Ishaq said: Jarir informed us; Uthman said: Jarir narrated to us, from Mughayrah, from al-Sha'bi, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, who said: I went on an expedition with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). He caught up with me while I was riding a water-carrying camel of mine that had become exhausted and could hardly move. He said: "What is the matter with your camel?" I said: It is ill. The Messenger of Allah fell behind, urged it and supplicated for it. It continued walking ahead at the front of the camels. He said to me: "How do you find your camel?" I said: It is well; your blessing has reached it. He said: "Will you sell it to me?" I felt shy, and we had no other water-carrying camel. I said: Yes. I sold it to him on condition that I could ride on its back until I reached Medina. I said to him: Messenger of Allah, I am newly married, and I asked his permission; he gave me permission. I went ahead of the people to Medina. When I arrived, my maternal uncle met me and asked about the camel. I told him what I had done with it, and he blamed me for it. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had said to me when I asked his permission: "Have you married a virgin or a previously married woman?" I said: I married a previously married woman. He said: "Why did you not marry a virgin, so that you could play with each other?" I said: Messenger of Allah, my father died, or was martyred, and I have young sisters. I disliked marrying someone of their age who would neither teach them good manners nor look after them, so I married a previously married woman to look after them and teach them good manners. When the Messenger of Allah arrived in Medina, I went to him in the morning with the camel. He gave me its price and returned it to me.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي، نَضْرَةَ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ فَتَخَلَّفَ نَاضِحِي ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَقَالَ فِيهِ فَنَخَسَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي ‏"‏ ارْكَبْ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ أَيْضًا قَالَ فَمَا زَالَ يَزِيدُنِي وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ وَاللَّهُ يَغْفِرُ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Jabir said: We were with the Prophet (peace be upon him) on a journey and my riding camel fell behind. The Messenger of Allah urged it and said: Ride it in Allah's name. He kept adding to the price and saying: May Allah forgive you. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Kamil al-Jahdari narrated to us; Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad narrated to us; al-Jurayri narrated to us, from Abu Nadrah, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, who said: We were with the Prophet (peace be upon him) on a journey and my water-carrying camel fell behind. He related the report, and in it he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prodded it, then said to me: "Ride, in the name of Allah." He also added: He kept giving me more and saying: "May Allah forgive you."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا أَتَى عَلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ أَعْيَا بَعِيرِي - قَالَ - فَنَخَسَهُ فَوَثَبَ - فَكُنْتُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ أَحْبِسُ خِطَامَهُ لأَسْمَعَ حَدِيثَهُ فَمَا أَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَحِقَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ بِعْنِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَبِعْتُهُ مِنْهُ بِخَمْسِ أَوَاقٍ - قَالَ - قُلْتُ عَلَى أَنَّ لِي ظَهْرَهُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلَكَ ظَهْرُهُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ أَتَيْتُهُ بِهِ فَزَادَنِي وُقِيَّةً ثُمَّ وَهَبَهُ لِي ‏.‏
before: Jabir said: The Prophet (peace be upon him) caught up with me when my camel was exhausted, urged it, and it sprang forward. I sold it to him for five uqiyyahs on the condition that I could ride it to Medina. When I arrived, he added an uqiyyah to the price and then gave the camel back to me. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu al-Rabi al-Ataki narrated to me; Hammad narrated to us; Ayyub narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) came upon me and my camel had become exhausted, he prodded it and it sprang forward. After that, I used to hold its reins back so I could hear his words, but I could not keep pace with him. The Prophet caught up with me and said: "Sell it to me." I sold it to him for five uqiyyahs. I said: On condition that I may ride it to Medina. He said: "You may ride it to Medina." When I arrived in Medina, I brought it to him. He gave me an additional uqiyyah, then gave the camel to me as a gift.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا بَشِيرُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَافَرْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ - أَظُنُّهُ قَالَ غَازِيًا - وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ وَزَادَ فِيهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا جَابِرُ أَتَوَفَّيْتَ الثَّمَنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَكَ الثَّمَنُ وَلَكَ الْجَمَلُ لَكَ الثَّمَنُ وَلَكَ الْجَمَلُ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Jabir travelled with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and the Prophet asked whether he had received the price. Jabir said yes. The Prophet said: The price is yours and the camel is yours; the price is yours and the camel is yours. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Uqbah ibn Mukram al-Ammi narrated to us; Yaqub ibn Ishaq narrated to us; Bashir ibn Uqbah narrated to us, from Abu al-Mutawakkil al-Naji, from Jabir, who said: I travelled with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on one of his journeys. I think he said it was on an expedition. He related the story and added in it that he said: "Jabir, have you received the price?" I said: Yes. He said: "The price is yours and the camel is yours; the price is yours and the camel is yours."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهُ ‏"‏ قَدْ أَخَذْتُ جَمَلَكَ بِأَرْبَعَةِ دَنَانِيرَ وَلَكَ ظَهْرُهُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said to Jabir: I have taken your camel for four dinars, and you may ride it to Medina. The complete report preserves the chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us; Ibn Abi Za'idah narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata, from Jabir, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said to him: "I have taken your camel for four dinars, and you may ride it to Medina."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ يَعْنِي أَبَا عَاصِمٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالاَ جَمِيعًا أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، وَعَنْ عَمِّهِ، عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ لاَ يَقْدَمُ مِنْ سَفَرٍ إِلاَّ نَهَارًا فِي الضُّحَى فَإِذَا قَدِمَ بَدَأَ بِالْمَسْجِدِ فَصَلَّى فِيهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ جَلَسَ فِيهِ ‏.‏
before: Ka'b ibn Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) never returned from a journey except in daylight, during the forenoon. When he arrived, he first went to the mosque, prayed two units there, and then sat in it. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us; al-Dahhak, meaning Abu Asim, narrated to us. And Mahmud ibn Ghaylan narrated to me; Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Both said: Ibn Jurayj informed us; Ibn Shihab informed me that Abd al-Rahman ibn Abdullah ibn Ka'b informed him, from his father Abdullah ibn Ka'b and from his uncle Ubaydullah ibn Ka'b, from Ka'b ibn Malik, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) never returned from a journey except in daylight, in the forenoon. When he arrived, he began at the mosque, prayed two units there, then sat in it.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُرَّةَ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ هَانِئٍ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَ أَوْصَانِي حَبِيبِي صلى الله عليه وسلم بِثَلاَثٍ لَنْ أَدَعَهُنَّ مَا عِشْتُ بِصِيَامِ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَصَلاَةِ الضُّحَى وَبِأَنْ لاَ أَنَامَ حَتَّى أُوتِرَ ‏.‏
before: Abu al-Darda said: My beloved (peace be upon him) advised me with three things that I will not abandon as long as I live: fasting three days of every month, praying Duha, and not sleeping until I have performed witr. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Harun ibn Abdullah and Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. They said: Ibn Abi Fudayk narrated to us, from al-Dahhak ibn Uthman, from Ibrahim ibn Abdullah ibn Hunayn, from Abu Murrah, the freedman of Umm Hani, from Abu al-Darda, who said: My beloved (peace be upon him) advised me to do three things that I would not leave as long as I lived: to fast three days of every month, to pray the forenoon prayer, and not to sleep until I had performed witr.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ هَلْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الضُّحَى قَالَتْ لاَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَجِيءَ مِنْ مَغِيبِهِ ‏.‏
before: Aisha was asked whether the Prophet (peace be upon him) used to pray Duha. She said: No, except when he returned from a journey. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
