after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated this to us; Yazid ibn Zuray informed us, from Sa'id al-Jurayri, from Abdullah ibn Shaqiq, who said: I asked Aishah, "Did the Prophet (peace be upon him) pray the forenoon prayer?" She said: "No, except when he returned from a journey."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا كَهْمَسُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الْقَيْسِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ أَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الضُّحَى قَالَتْ لاَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَجِيءَ مِنْ مَغِيبِهِ
before: Aisha was asked whether the Prophet (peace be upon him) prayed Duha. She said: No, except when he returned from a journey. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ubaydullah ibn Muadh narrated to us; my father narrated to us; Kahmas ibn al-Hasan al-Qaysi narrated to us, from Abdullah ibn Shaqiq, who said: I asked Aishah, "Did the Prophet (peace be upon him) pray the forenoon prayer?" She said: "No, except when he returned from a journey."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي الرِّشْكَ - حَدَّثَتْنِي مُعَاذَةُ، أَنَّهَا سَأَلَتْ عَائِشَةَ - رضى الله عنها - كَمْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي صَلاَةَ الضُّحَى قَالَتْ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ وَيَزِيدُ مَا شَاءَ ‏.‏
before: Muadhah asked Aisha how many units the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed for Duha. She said: Four units, and he increased as Allah willed. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Shayban ibn Farrukh narrated to us; Abd al-Warith narrated to us; Yazid, meaning al-Rishk, narrated to us; Muadhah narrated to me that she asked Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her): "How many units did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) pray for the forenoon prayer?" She said: "Four units, and he would add whatever Allah willed."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، أَنَّ مُعَاذَةَ الْعَدَوِيَّةَ، حَدَّثَتْهُمْ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الضُّحَى أَرْبَعًا وَيَزِيدُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to pray four units of Duha and would increase as Allah willed. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Habib al-Harithi narrated to me; Khalid ibn al-Harith narrated to us, from Sa'id. Qatadah narrated to us that Muadhah al-Adawiyyah narrated to them from Aishah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to pray four units for the forenoon prayer, and he would add whatever Allah willed.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ الضُّبَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيٌّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مَيْمُونٍ - حَدَّثَنَا وَاصِلٌ، مَوْلَى أَبِي عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ يَعْمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ الدُّؤَلِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ يُصْبِحُ عَلَى كُلِّ سُلاَمَى مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ صَدَقَةٌ فَكُلُّ تَسْبِيحَةٍ صَدَقَةٌ وَكُلُّ تَحْمِيدَةٍ صَدَقَةٌ وَكُلُّ تَهْلِيلَةٍ صَدَقَةٌ وَكُلُّ تَكْبِيرَةٍ صَدَقَةٌ وَأَمْرٌ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ صَدَقَةٌ وَنَهْىٌ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ صَدَقَةٌ وَيُجْزِئُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ رَكْعَتَانِ يَرْكَعُهُمَا مِنَ الضُّحَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Dharr reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: In the morning, charity is due from every joint of each of you. Every glorification is charity, every praise is charity, every declaration of Allah's oneness is charity, every takbir is charity, commanding what is right is charity, and forbidding what is wrong is charity. Two units of Duha prayer suffice for all of that. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Asma al-Duba'i narrated to us; Mahdi, who is Ibn Maymun, narrated to us; Wasil, the freedman of Abu Uyaynah, narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Uqayl, from Yahya ibn Ya'mar, from Abu al-Aswad al-Du'ali, from Abu Dharr, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), that he said: "Every morning, charity is due from each of your joints. Every glorification of Allah is charity, every praise of Allah is charity, every declaration that there is no god but Allah is charity, every declaration of Allah's greatness is charity, enjoining what is right is charity, and forbidding what is wrong is charity. Two units that a person prays in the forenoon suffice for all of that."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو التَّيَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَوْصَانِي خَلِيلِي صلى الله عليه وسلم بِثَلاَثٍ بِصِيَامِ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَرَكْعَتَىِ الضُّحَى وَأَنْ أُوتِرَ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْقُدَ ‏.‏
before: Abu Hurayra said: My beloved, the Prophet (peace be upon him), advised me to fast three days of every month, pray two units of Duha, and perform witr before sleeping. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Shayban ibn Farrukh narrated to us; Abd al-Warith narrated to us; Abu al-Tayyah narrated to us; Abu Uthman al-Nahdi narrated to me, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: My close friend (peace be upon him) advised me to do three things: to fast three days of every month, to pray two units forenoon prayer, and to perform witr before I sleep.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبَّاسٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، وَأَبِي، شِمْرٍ الضُّبَعِيِّ قَالاَ سَمِعْنَا أَبَا عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيَّ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
before: Abu Hurayra reported the same advice from the Prophet (peace be upon him): fasting three days each month, two units of Duha, and witr before sleeping. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated this to us. They said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, from Abbas al-Jurayri and Abu Shimr al-Duba'i, who both said: We heard Abu Uthman al-Nahdi narrating from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), something like it.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُخْتَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الدَّانَاجِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو رَافِعٍ الصَّائِغُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَوْصَانِي خَلِيلِي أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِثَلاَثٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏
before: Abu Hurayra said: My beloved Abu al-Qasim (peace be upon him) advised me with three things, and he mentioned the same report as Abu Uthman's narration from Abu Hurayra. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Sulayman ibn Ma'bad narrated this to me; Mualla ibn Asad narrated to us; Abd al-Aziz ibn Mukhtar narrated to us, from Abdullah al-Danaj, who said: Abu Rafi al-Sa'igh narrated to me, saying: I heard Abu Hurayrah say: My close friend Abu al-Qasim (peace be upon him) advised me to do three things. He mentioned a report like that of Abu Uthman from Abu Hurayrah.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ كَمَا قَالَ مَالِكٌ ‏.‏
before: The narrators transmitted this report from Nafi with the chain of Malik and the same meaning. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya, Qutaybah and Ibn Rumh narrated this to us, from al-Layth ibn Sa'd. And Zuhayr ibn Harb and Ubaydullah ibn Sa'id narrated to me. They said: Yahya narrated to us, from Ubaydullah. And Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Ismail narrated to us, from Ayyub. All of them narrated from Nafi, with this chain, as Malik said.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ نَافِعًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ لاَ يُصَلِّي إِلاَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
before: Hafsah said: When dawn rose, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed only two light units. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn al-Hakam narrated to me; Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, from Zayd ibn Muhammad, who said: I heard Nafi narrating from Ibn Umar, from Hafsah, who said: When dawn broke, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) would pray only two brief units.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَخْبَرَتْنِي حَفْصَةُ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَضَاءَ لَهُ الْفَجْرُ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
before: Hafsah reported that when dawn became clear to him, the Prophet (peace be upon him) prayed two units. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Abbad narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Amr, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from his father. Hafsah informed me that when dawn became bright for the Prophet (peace be upon him), he would pray two units.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَىِ الْفَجْرِ إِذَا سَمِعَ الأَذَانَ وَيُخَفِّفُهُمَا ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to pray the two units of Fajr when he heard the call to prayer, and he made them brief. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Amr al-Naqid narrated to us; Abdah ibn Sulayman narrated to us; Hisham ibn Urwah narrated to us, from his father, from Aishah, who said: When he heard the call to prayer, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) would pray the two units before dawn and make them brief.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ إِذَا طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ ‏.‏
before: The narrators transmitted the same chain and wording from Hisham. Abu Usamah's version says: when dawn rose. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ali ibn Hujr narrated this to me; Ali, meaning Ibn Mushir, narrated to us. And Abu Kurayb narrated this to us; Abu Usamah narrated to us. And Abu Bakr, Abu Kurayb and Ibn Numayr narrated this to us, from Abdullah ibn Numayr. And Amr al-Naqid narrated this to us; Waki narrated to us. All of them narrated from Hisham with this chain. Abu Usamah's narration says: "When dawn broke."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَيْنَ النِّدَاءِ وَالإِقَامَةِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ ‏.‏
before: Aisha reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) used to pray two units between the call to prayer and the beginning of the Fajr prayer. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated this to us; Ibn Abi Adi narrated to us, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Abu Salamah, from Aishah, that the Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him) used to pray two units between the call and the start of the dawn prayer.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَمْرَةَ، تُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَىِ الْفَجْرِ فَيُخَفِّفُ حَتَّى إِنِّي أَقُولُ هَلْ قَرَأَ فِيهِمَا بِأُمِّ الْقُرْآنِ ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to pray the two units of Fajr and make them so brief that I would wonder whether he had recited the Mother of the Quran in them. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us; Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us, saying: I heard Yahya ibn Sa'id. Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman informed me that he heard Amrah narrating from Aishah, who used to say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) would pray the two units before dawn so briefly that I would say: Did he recite the Opening of the Book in them?

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، سَمِعَ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ أَقُولُ هَلْ يَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: When dawn appeared, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed two units, and I would wonder whether he recited the Opening of the Book in them. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ubaydullah ibn Muadh narrated to us; my father narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Ansari, who heard Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman, from Aishah, who said: When dawn broke, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed two units. I would say: Does he recite the Opening of the Book in them?

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءٌ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَى شَىْءٍ مِنَ النَّوَافِلِ أَشَدَّ مُعَاهَدَةً مِنْهُ عَلَى رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الصُّبْحِ ‏.‏
before: Aisha reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) was not more constant in any voluntary prayer than in the two units before Fajr. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me; Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, who said: Ata narrated to me, from Ubayd ibn Umayr, from Aishah, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) was not more constant in observing any voluntary prayer than he was in observing two units before dawn.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبِي حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي شَأْنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ ‏"‏ لَهُمَا أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا جَمِيعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Aisha reported from the Prophet (peace be upon him) concerning the two units at dawn: They are more beloved to me than the whole world. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Habib narrated to us; Mu'tamir narrated to us, saying: My father said: Qatadah narrated to us, from Zurara, from Sa'd ibn Hisham, from Aishah, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said concerning the two units at dawn: "They are more beloved to me than the whole world."

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، - هُوَ ابْنُ كَيْسَانَ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَرَأَ فِي رَكْعَتَىِ الْفَجْرِ ‏[quran sura="109" aya_start="1" aya_end="1"]{‏ قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ‏}‏ وَ ‏[quran sura="112" aya_start="1" aya_end="1"]{‏ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ‏}‏
before: Abu Hurayra reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) recited in the two units of Fajr: Say, O disbelievers (Quran 109:1, verse 1), and Say: He is Allah, One (Quran 112:1, verse 1). The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Abbad and Ibn Abi Umar narrated to me. They said: Marwan ibn Muawiyah narrated to us, from Yazid, who is Ibn Kaysan, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) recited in the two units before dawn: "Say: O disbelievers" (Quran 109:1) and "Say: He is Allah, One" (Quran 112:1).

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَزَارِيُّ، - يَعْنِي مَرْوَانَ بْنَ مُعَاوِيَةَ - عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي رَكْعَتَىِ الْفَجْرِ فِي الأُولَى مِنْهُمَا ‏[quran sura="2" aya_start="136" aya_end="136"]{‏ قُولُوا آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْنَا‏}‏ الآيَةَ الَّتِي فِي الْبَقَرَةِ وَفِي الآخِرَةِ مِنْهُمَا ‏[quran sura="3" aya_start="52" aya_end="52"]{‏ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَاشْهَدْ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ‏}‏
before: Ibn Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to recite in the two units of Fajr, in the first: We believe in Allah and what was sent down to us (Quran 2:136, verse 136), and in the second: We believe in Allah, and bear witness that we are Muslims (Quran 3:52, verse 52). The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated this to us; al-Fazari, meaning Marwan ibn Muawiyah, narrated to us, from Uthman ibn Hakim al-Ansari, who said: Sa'id ibn Yasar informed me that Ibn Abbas informed him that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to recite in the first of the two units before dawn: "Say: We believe in Allah and what was sent down to us" (Quran 2:136), the verse in al-Baqarah, and in the second of them: "We believe in Allah, and bear witness that we are Muslims" (Quran 3:52).

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي رَكْعَتَىِ الْفَجْرِ ‏[quran sura="2" aya_start="136" aya_end="136"]{‏ قُولُوا آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْنَا‏}‏ وَالَّتِي فِي آلِ عِمْرَانَ ‏[quran sura="3" aya_start="64" aya_end="64"]{‏ تَعَالَوْا إِلَى كَلِمَةٍ سَوَاءٍ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ‏}‏
before: Ibn Abbas said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to recite in the two units of Fajr: We believe in Allah and what was sent down to us (Quran 2:136, verse 136), and the verse in the family of Imran: Come to a word equal between us and you (Quran 3:64, verse 64). The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated this to us; Abu Khalid al-Ahmar narrated to us, from Uthman ibn Hakim, from Sa'id ibn Yasar, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to recite in the two units before dawn: "Say: We believe in Allah and what was sent down to us" (Quran 2:136), and the verse in Al Imran: "Come to a word that is equitable between us and you" (Quran 3:64).

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ، - يَعْنِي سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ حَيَّانَ - عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَوْسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَنْبَسَةُ بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ بِحَدِيثٍ يُتَسَارُّ إِلَيْهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ تَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَنْ صَلَّى اثْنَتَىْ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً فِي يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ بُنِيَ لَهُ بِهِنَّ بَيْتٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ فَمَا تَرَكْتُهُنَّ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُهُنَّ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَنْبَسَةُ فَمَا تَرَكْتُهُنَّ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُهُنَّ مِنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ أَوْسٍ مَا تَرَكْتُهُنَّ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُهُنَّ مِنْ عَنْبَسَةَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ مَا تَرَكْتُهُنَّ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُهُنَّ مِنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَوْسٍ ‏.‏
before: Umm Habibah reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever prays twelve units in a day and night, a house will be built for him in Paradise. She said: I have not abandoned them since I heard them from the Messenger of Allah. Anbasah said the same after hearing it from Umm Habibah, and Amr ibn Aws and al-Numan ibn Salim said the same after hearing it from their teachers. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us; Abu Khalid, meaning Sulayman ibn Hayyan, narrated to us, from Dawud ibn Abi Hind, from al-Nu'man ibn Salim, from Amr ibn Aws, who said: Anbasah ibn Abi Sufyan narrated to me, during the illness in which he died, a report he whispered to him. He said: I heard Umm Habibah say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: "Whoever prays twelve units in a day and night will have a house built for him in Paradise by means of them." Umm Habibah said: I have not stopped praying them since I heard them from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). Anbasah said: I have not stopped praying them since I heard them from Umm Habibah. Amr ibn Aws said: I have not stopped praying them since I heard them from Anbasah. Al-Nu'man ibn Salim said: I have not stopped praying them since I heard them from Amr ibn Aws.

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏"‏ مَنْ صَلَّى فِي يَوْمٍ ثِنْتَىْ عَشْرَةَ سَجْدَةً تَطَوُّعًا بُنِيَ لَهُ بَيْتٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Whoever prays twelve voluntary prostrations in a day, a house will be built for him in Paradise. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Ghassan al-Misma'i narrated to me; Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal narrated to us; Dawud narrated to us, from al-Nu'man ibn Salim, with this chain: "Whoever prays twelve prostrations voluntarily in a day will have a house built for him in Paradise."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَوْسٍ، عَنْ عَنْبَسَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ مُسْلِمٍ يُصَلِّي لِلَّهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ ثِنْتَىْ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً تَطَوُّعًا غَيْرَ فَرِيضَةٍ إِلاَّ بَنَى اللَّهُ لَهُ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَوْ إِلاَّ بُنِيَ لَهُ بَيْتٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ فَمَا بَرِحْتُ أُصَلِّيهِنَّ بَعْدُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَمْرٌو مَا بَرِحْتُ أُصَلِّيهِنَّ بَعْدُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ النُّعْمَانُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
before: Umm Habibah reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: No Muslim servant prays twelve voluntary units every day, apart from the obligatory prayer, except that Allah builds a house for him in Paradise. Umm Habibah, Amr and al-Numan said that they continued praying them afterward. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us; Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, from al-Nu'man ibn Salim, from Amr ibn Aws, from Anbasah ibn Abi Sufyan, from Umm Habibah, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: "There is no Muslim servant who prays twelve voluntary units to Allah each day, other than the obligatory prayers, but Allah will build him a house in Paradise, or a house will be built for him in Paradise." Umm Habibah said: I have continued praying them ever since. Amr said: I have continued praying them ever since. Al-Nu'man said the same.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ أَخْبَرَنِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ أَوْسٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَنْبَسَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ مُسْلِمٍ تَوَضَّأَ فَأَسْبَغَ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى لِلَّهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
before: Umm Habibah reported the same promise for a Muslim who performs wudu thoroughly and prays twelve voluntary units every day. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr and Abdullah ibn Hashim al-Abdi narrated to me. They said: Bahz narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us. Al-Nu'man ibn Salim said: He informed me, saying: I heard Amr ibn Aws narrating from Anbasah, from Umm Habibah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "There is no Muslim servant who performs ablution and does it well, then prays to Allah each day..." He mentioned a report like it.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَبَعْدَهَا سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَبَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَبَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَبَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ سَجْدَتَيْنِ فَأَمَّا الْمَغْرِبُ وَالْعِشَاءُ وَالْجُمُعَةُ فَصَلَّيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِهِ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar said: I prayed with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) two units before Zuhr, two after it, two after Maghrib, two after Isha, and two after Friday. As for Maghrib, Isha and Friday, I prayed them with the Prophet in his house. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Ubaydullah ibn Sa'id narrated to me. They said: Yahya, who is Ibn Sa'id, narrated to us, from Ubaydullah, who said: Nafi informed me, from Ibn Umar. And Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us; Abu Usamah narrated to us; Ubaydullah narrated to us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, who said: I prayed with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) two units before Zuhr and two after it, two after Maghrib, two after Isha, and two after Friday prayer. As for Maghrib, Isha and Friday prayer, I prayed them with the Prophet (peace be upon him) in his house.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ بُدَيْلٍ، وَأَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي لَيْلاً طَوِيلاً فَإِذَا صَلَّى قَائِمًا رَكَعَ قَائِمًا وَإِذَا صَلَّى قَاعِدًا رَكَعَ قَاعِدًا ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed for a long time at night. When he prayed standing, he bowed standing, and when he prayed sitting, he bowed sitting. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us; Hammad narrated to us, from Budayl and Ayyub, from Abdullah ibn Shaqiq, from Aishah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) would pray for a long time at night. When he prayed standing, he bowed while standing, and when he prayed seated, he bowed while seated.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ الْعُقَيْلِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ عَنْ صَلاَةِ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِاللَّيْلِ فَقَالَتْ كَانَ يُصَلِّي لَيْلاً طَوِيلاً قَائِمًا وَلَيْلاً طَوِيلاً قَاعِدًا وَكَانَ إِذَا قَرَأَ قَائِمًا رَكَعَ قَائِمًا وَإِذَا قَرَأَ قَاعِدًا رَكَعَ قَاعِدًا ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed for a long time at night standing and for a long time sitting. When he recited standing, he bowed standing; when he recited sitting, he bowed sitting. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated this to us; Muadh ibn Muadh narrated to us, from Humayd, from Abdullah ibn Shaqiq al-Uqayli, who said: I asked Aishah about the Messenger of Allah's (peace be upon him) night prayer. She said: He would pray for a long time standing and for a long time seated. When he recited standing, he bowed while standing, and when he recited seated, he bowed while seated.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ الْعُقَيْلِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْنَا عَائِشَةَ عَنْ صَلاَةِ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُكْثِرُ الصَّلاَةَ قَائِمًا وَقَاعِدًا فَإِذَا افْتَتَحَ الصَّلاَةَ قَائِمًا رَكَعَ قَائِمًا وَإِذَا افْتَتَحَ الصَّلاَةَ قَاعِدًا رَكَعَ قَاعِدًا ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) often prayed standing and sitting. When he began the prayer standing, he bowed standing, and when he began it sitting, he bowed sitting. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated this to us; Abu Muawiyah informed us, from Hisham ibn Hassan, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Abdullah ibn Shaqiq al-Uqayli, who said: We asked Aishah about the Messenger of Allah's (peace be upon him) prayer. She said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed much standing and seated. When he began the prayer standing, he bowed standing, and when he began the prayer seated, he bowed seated.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ جَالِسًا حَتَّى إِذَا كَبِرَ قَرَأَ جَالِسًا حَتَّى إِذَا بَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ السُّورَةِ ثَلاَثُونَ أَوْ أَرْبَعُونَ آيَةً قَامَ فَقَرَأَهُنَّ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: I never saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) recite any night prayer sitting until he grew older. Then he recited sitting, and when thirty or forty verses remained from the surah, he stood, recited them, and bowed. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani narrated to me; Hammad, meaning Ibn Zayd, informed us. He said: Hasan ibn al-Rabi narrated to us; Mahdi ibn Maymun narrated to us. And Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us; Waki narrated to us. And Abu Kurayb narrated to us; Ibn Numayr narrated to us. All of them narrated from Hisham ibn Urwah. And Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me, and this is his wording. He said: Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Hisham ibn Urwah, who said: My father informed me, from Aishah, who said: I never saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) recite any of the night prayer seated until he grew older. Then he would recite seated, and when thirty or forty verses remained of the surah, he would stand, recite them, then bow.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، وَأَبِي النَّضْرِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي جَالِسًا فَيَقْرَأُ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ فَإِذَا بَقِيَ مِنْ قِرَاءَتِهِ قَدْرُ مَا يَكُونُ ثَلاَثِينَ أَوْ أَرْبَعِينَ آيَةً قَامَ فَقَرَأَ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ ثُمَّ يَفْعَلُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to pray sitting and recite sitting. When the amount remaining of his recitation was about thirty or forty verses, he stood, recited standing, bowed, prostrated, and did the same in the second unit. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated this to us, saying: I read to Malik, from Abdullah ibn Yazid and Abu al-Nadr, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Aishah, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to pray seated and recite while seated. When about thirty or forty verses' worth of his recitation remained, he would stand and recite while standing, then bow and prostrate. He would do the same in the second unit.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ وَهُوَ قَاعِدٌ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ قَامَ قَدْرَ مَا يَقْرَأُ إِنْسَانٌ أَرْبَعِينَ آيَةً ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) recited while sitting. When he wanted to bow, he stood for the time a person would recite forty verses, and then bowed. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. Abu Bakr said: Ismail ibn Ulayyah narrated to us, from al-Walid ibn Abi Hisham, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad, from Amrah, from Aishah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) would recite while seated. When he wished to bow, he would stand for long enough for a person to recite forty verses.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ كَيْفَ كَانَ يَصْنَعُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ قَالَتْ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ قَامَ فَرَكَعَ ‏.‏
before: Aisha was asked how the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed the two units while sitting. She said: He recited in them, and when he wanted to bow, he stood and then bowed. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ibn Numayr narrated this to us; Muhammad ibn Bishr narrated to us; Muhammad ibn Amr narrated to us; Muhammad ibn Ibrahim narrated to me, from Alqamah ibn Waqqas, who said: I asked Aishah, "How did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) pray the two units while seated?" She said: He recited in them, and when he wanted to bow, he stood and bowed.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَمُتْ حَتَّى كَانَ كَثِيرٌ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ ‏.‏
before: Aisha reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) did not die until much of his prayer was performed sitting. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Hatim and Harun ibn Abdullah narrated to me. They said: Hajjaj ibn Muhammad narrated to us. He said: Ibn Jurayj said: Uthman ibn Abi Sulayman informed me that Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman informed him that Aishah informed him that the Prophet (peace be upon him) did not die until much of his prayer was performed while seated.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَحَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ حَسَنٌ حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، حَدَّثَنِي الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا بَدَّنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَثَقُلَ كَانَ أَكْثَرُ صَلاَتِهِ جَالِسًا ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) became older and heavier, most of his prayer was sitting. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Hatim and Hasan al-Hulwani narrated to me, both from Zayd. Hasan said: Zayd ibn al-Hubab narrated to us; al-Dahhak ibn Uthman narrated to me; Abdullah ibn Urwah narrated to me, from his father, from Aishah, who said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) grew older and became heavy, most of his prayer was seated.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ أَبِي وَدَاعَةَ السَّهْمِيِّ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى فِي سُبْحَتِهِ قَاعِدًا حَتَّى كَانَ قَبْلَ وَفَاتِهِ بِعَامٍ فَكَانَ يُصَلِّي فِي سُبْحَتِهِ قَاعِدًا وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ بِالسُّورَةِ فَيُرَتِّلُهَا حَتَّى تَكُونَ أَطْوَلَ مِنْ أَطْوَلَ مِنْهَا ‏.‏
before: Hafsah said: I never saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) pray his voluntary prayer sitting until the year before his death. Then he prayed his voluntary prayer sitting and recited a surah slowly, making it longer than a longer surah. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, saying: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid, from al-Muttalib ibn Abi Wada'ah al-Sahmi, from Hafsah, who said: I did not see the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) pray a voluntary prayer seated until the year before his death. After that, he prayed his voluntary prayer seated and recited a surah in measured tones until it became longer than a longer one.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ بِعَامٍ وَاحِدٍ أَوِ اثْنَيْنِ ‏.‏
before: The narrators transmitted the same report from al-Zuhri. Their wording says: one year or two years. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah narrated this to me. They said: Ibn Wahb informed us; Yunus informed me. And Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us. They said: Abd al-Razzaq informed us; Ma'mar informed us. Both routes are from al-Zuhri, with this chain and a similar report, except that they said: "one year or two."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى الأَعْرَجِ، ‏.‏
before: The narrators transmitted this report from Mansur with the same chain. Shuba's narration names Abu Yahya al-A'raj. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated this to us, all from Muhammad ibn Ja'far, from Shu'bah. And Ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us; Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us. Both narrated from Mansur with this chain. Shu'bah's narration says: "from Abu Yahya al-A'raj."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي بِاللَّيْلِ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً يُوتِرُ مِنْهَا بِوَاحِدَةٍ فَإِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْهَا اضْطَجَعَ عَلَى شِقِّهِ الأَيْمَنِ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to pray eleven units at night, making one of them witr. When he finished, he lay on his right side until the caller came, and then he prayed two light units. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, saying: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah, from Aishah, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to pray eleven units at night, making one of them witr. When he finished, he would lie down on his right side until the caller to prayer came to him, and then he would pray two brief units.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي فِيمَا بَيْنَ أَنْ يَفْرُغَ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ - وَهِيَ الَّتِي يَدْعُو النَّاسُ الْعَتَمَةَ - إِلَى الْفَجْرِ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً يُسَلِّمُ بَيْنَ كُلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَيُوتِرُ بِوَاحِدَةٍ فَإِذَا سَكَتَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُ الْفَجْرُ وَجَاءَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ قَامَ فَرَكَعَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ عَلَى شِقِّهِ الأَيْمَنِ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ لِلإِقَامَةِ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَرْمَلَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ حَرْمَلَةُ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُ الْفَجْرُ وَجَاءَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الإِقَامَةَ ‏.‏ وَسَائِرُ الْحَدِيثِ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عَمْرٍو سَوَاءً ‏.‏
before: Aisha said: Between finishing Isha, which people call Atamah, and Fajr, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed eleven units at night. He gave salam after every two units and performed witr with one. When the caller finished the Fajr call and dawn became clear, he stood and prayed two light units, then lay on his right side until the caller came to begin the prayer. The narrators transmitted the same report with minor omissions. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me; Ibn Wahb narrated to us; Amr ibn al-Harith informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from Aishah, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to pray eleven units between finishing the Isha prayer, which people call al-Atamah, and dawn. He would say the salutation after every two units and perform witr with one unit. When the caller to the dawn prayer had finished and dawn had become clear to him, and the caller came to him, he would rise and pray two brief units. Then he would lie on his right side until the caller came to announce the start of prayer. Harmalah narrated this to me; Ibn Wahb informed us; Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab with this chain. Harmalah related the report similarly, except that he did not mention "dawn had become clear to him and the caller came to him," and he did not mention the start of prayer. The rest of the report is exactly like Amr's report.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَاهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ نَامَ عَنْ حِزْبِهِ أَوْ عَنْ شَىْءٍ مِنْهُ فَقَرَأَهُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ وَصَلاَةِ الظُّهْرِ كُتِبَ لَهُ كَأَنَّمَا قَرَأَهُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Umar ibn al-Khattab reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever sleeps through his regular portion of recitation, or part of it, and recites it between Fajr and Zuhr, it will be recorded for him as though he had recited it at night. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Harun ibn Ma'ruf narrated to us; Abdullah ibn Wahb narrated to us. And Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah narrated to me. They said: Ibn Wahb informed us, from Yunus ibn Yazid, from Ibn Shihab, from al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid and Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, who informed him, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abd al-Qari, who said: I heard Umar ibn al-Khattab say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever sleeps through his regular portion of prayer or some of it, then recites it between the dawn prayer and the noon prayer, it will be recorded for him as though he had recited it at night."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى فَإِذَا خَشِيَ أَحَدُكُمُ الصُّبْحَ صَلَّى رَكْعَةً وَاحِدَةً تُوتِرُ لَهُ مَا قَدْ صَلَّى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar reported that a man asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) about the night prayer. He said: The night prayer is two by two. When one of you fears dawn, let him pray one unit to make what he has prayed odd. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated this to us, saying: I read to Malik, from Nafi and Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar, that a man asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) about the night prayer. The Messenger of Allah said: "The night prayer is two by two. When one of you fears dawn, let him pray one unit, making what he has prayed an odd number."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى فَإِذَا خَشِيتَ الصُّبْحَ فَأَوْتِرْ بِرَكْعَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: The night prayer is two by two. When you fear dawn, perform witr with one unit. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Amr al-Naqid and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us. Zuhayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from his father, who heard the Prophet (peace be upon him) say... And Muhammad ibn Abbad narrated to us, and this is his wording: Sufyan narrated to us; Amr narrated to us, from Tawus, from Ibn Umar. And al-Zuhri narrated from Salim, from his father, that a man asked the Prophet (peace be upon him) about the night prayer. He said: "Two by two. When you fear dawn, perform witr with one unit."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ وَحُمَيْدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ حَدَّثَاهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى فَإِذَا خِفْتَ الصُّبْحَ فَأَوْتِرْ بِوَاحِدَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar said: A man stood and asked: O Messenger of Allah, how is the night prayer? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Two by two. When you fear dawn, perform witr with one unit. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me; Abdullah ibn Wahb narrated to us; Amr informed me that Ibn Shihab related to him that Salim ibn Abdullah ibn Umar and Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf related to him from Abdullah ibn Umar ibn al-Khattab, who said: A man stood and said: Messenger of Allah, how is the night prayer? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "The night prayer is two by two. When you fear dawn, perform witr with one unit."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، وَبُدَيْلٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ السَّائِلِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى فَإِذَا خَشِيتَ الصُّبْحَ فَصَلِّ رَكْعَةً وَاجْعَلْ آخِرَ صَلاَتِكَ وِتْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ عَلَى رَأْسِ الْحَوْلِ وَأَنَا بِذَلِكَ الْمَكَانِ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ أَدْرِي هُوَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ أَوْ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ فَقَالَ لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
before: Abdullah ibn Umar reported that a man asked the Prophet (peace be upon him), while I was between them, how the night prayer was performed. He said: Two by two. When you fear dawn, pray one unit and make the last of your prayer witr. A year later a man asked him the same question, but I do not know whether he was the same man or another, and he gave him the same answer. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani narrated to me; Hammad narrated to us; Ayyub and Budayl narrated to us, from Abdullah ibn Shaqiq, from Abdullah ibn Umar, that a man asked the Prophet (peace be upon him), while I was between him and the questioner: "Messenger of Allah, how is the night prayer?" He said: "Two by two. When you fear dawn, pray one unit and make the last of your prayer witr." Then, at the end of a year, a man asked him while I was in that same place with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). I do not know whether it was that same man or another. He gave him the same answer.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، وَبُدَيْلٌ، وَعِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُدَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، وَالزُّبَيْرُ بْنُ الْخِرِّيتِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَا بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ عَلَى رَأْسِ الْحَوْلِ وَمَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
before: The narrators transmitted the same answer from Ibn Umar, without the later question that appears in the preceding report. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Kamil narrated to me; Hammad narrated to us; Ayyub, Budayl and Imran ibn Hudayr narrated to us, from Abdullah ibn Shaqiq, from Ibn Umar. And Muhammad ibn Ubayd al-Ghubari narrated to us; Hammad narrated to us; Ayyub and al-Zubayr ibn al-Khurrit narrated to us, from Abdullah ibn Shaqiq, from Ibn Umar, who said: A man asked the Prophet (peace be upon him). They related a report like it, but their two narrations do not include: "Then a man asked him at the end of a year and afterward."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ وَمَنْ قَامَ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Hurayra reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever fasts Ramadan in faith and seeking reward will be forgiven his previous sins, and whoever stands on the Night of Decree in faith and seeking reward will be forgiven his previous sins. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me; Muadh ibn Hisham narrated to us; my father narrated to me, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, who said: Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman narrated to us that Abu Hurayrah related to them that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever fasts Ramadan with faith and seeking reward will be forgiven for his past sins. Whoever stands in prayer on the Night of Decree with faith and seeking reward will be forgiven for his past sins."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً نَادَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ أُوتِرُ صَلاَةَ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ صَلَّى فَلْيُصَلِّ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى فَإِنْ أَحَسَّ أَنْ يُصْبِحَ سَجَدَ سَجْدَةً فَأَوْتَرَتْ لَهُ مَا صَلَّى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ‏.‏
before: A man called to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) while he was in the mosque and asked how to perform witr at night. He said: Whoever prays should pray two by two. When he feels that dawn is near, let him pray one unit, making witr for what he has prayed. Abu Kurayb said that the narrator was Ubayd Allah ibn Abdullah, not Ibn Umar. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Kurayb and Harun ibn Abdullah narrated to us. They said: Abu Usamah narrated to us, from al-Walid ibn Kathir, who said: Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Umar narrated to me that Ibn Umar related to them that a man called out to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) while he was in the mosque and said: Messenger of Allah, how should I make the night prayer witr? The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever prays, let him pray two by two. If he senses that morning is coming, let him pray one unit, making the prayer he has performed an odd number." Abu Kurayb said: It was Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, and he did not say "Ibn Umar."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَسُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، - قَالَ هَارُونُ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، - أَخْبَرَنِي عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ بَادِرُوا الصُّبْحَ بِالْوِتْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Hasten to perform witr before dawn. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Harun ibn Ma'ruf, Surayj ibn Yunus and Abu Kurayb narrated this to us, all from Ibn Abi Za'idah. Harun said: Ibn Abi Za'idah narrated to us; Asim al-Ahwal informed me, from Abdullah ibn Shaqiq, from Ibn Umar, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Hasten to perform witr before dawn."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ مَنْ صَلَّى مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَلْيَجْعَلْ آخِرَ صَلاَتِهِ وِتْرًا فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْمُرُ بِذَلِكَ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar said: Whoever prays at night should make the last of his prayer witr, for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to command this. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us; Layth narrated to us. And Ibn Rumh narrated to us; al-Layth informed us, from Nafi, that Ibn Umar said: Whoever prays at night, let him make the last of his prayer witr, for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to command that.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ اجْعَلُوا آخِرَ صَلاَتِكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وِتْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Make the last of your night prayer witr. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us; Abu Usamah narrated to us. And Ibn Numayr narrated to us; my father narrated to us. And Zuhayr ibn Harb and Ibn al-Muthanna narrated to me. They said: Yahya narrated to us. All of them narrated from Ubaydullah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: "Make the last of your night prayer witr."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ يَقُولُ مَنْ صَلَّى مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَلْيَجْعَلْ آخِرَ صَلاَتِهِ وِتْرًا قَبْلَ الصُّبْحِ كَذَلِكَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُهُمْ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar used to say: Whoever prays at night should make the last of his prayer witr before dawn. This is what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to command them. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Harun ibn Abdullah narrated to me; Hajjaj ibn Muhammad narrated to us. He said: Ibn Jurayj said: Nafi informed me that Ibn Umar used to say: Whoever prays at night, let him make the last of his prayer witr before dawn. This is what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to command them to do.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو مِجْلَزٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْوِتْرُ رَكْعَةٌ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Witr is one unit at the end of the night. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Shayban ibn Farrukh narrated to us; Abd al-Warith narrated to us, from Abu al-Tayyah, who said: Abu Mijlaz narrated to me, from Ibn Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "Witr is one unit at the end of the night."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْوِتْرُ رَكْعَةٌ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Umar reported from the Prophet (peace be upon him): Witr is one unit at the end of the night. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated this to us. Ibn al-Muthanna said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Abu Mijlaz, who said: I heard Ibn Umar relating from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: "Witr is one unit at the end of the night."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ الْوِتْرِ، فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ رَكْعَةٌ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ رَكْعَةٌ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas and Ibn Umar both reported that they heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: One unit at the end of the night. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me; Abd al-Samad narrated to us; Hammam narrated to us; Qatadah narrated to us, from Abu Mijlaz, who said: I asked Ibn Abbas about witr, and he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: "One unit at the end of the night." I asked Ibn Umar, and he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: "One unit at the end of the night."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوْتِرُوا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُصْبِحُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Perform witr before morning. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us; Abd al-A'la ibn Abd al-A'la narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Perform witr before morning comes."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو نَضْرَةَ الْعَوَقِيُّ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ، سَأَلُوا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْوِتْرِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَوْتِرُوا قَبْلَ الصُّبْحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Said reported that people asked the Prophet (peace be upon him) about witr, and he said: Perform witr before dawn. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated this to me; Ubaydullah informed me, from Shayban, from Yahya, who said: Abu Nadrah al-Awqi informed me that Abu Sa'id informed them that they had asked the Prophet (peace be upon him) about witr. He said: "Perform witr before dawn."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَفْضَلُ الصَّلاَةِ طُولُ الْقُنُوتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Jabir reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: The best prayer is the one with the longest standing. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us; Abu Asim informed us; Ibn Jurayj informed us; Abu al-Zubayr informed me, from Jabir, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "The best prayer is that in which the standing is long."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الصَّلاَةِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ طُولُ الْقُنُوتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ ‏.‏
before: Jabir reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was asked which prayer was best. He said: The one with the longest standing. Abu Bakr said: Abu Muawiyah narrated to us from al-Amash. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb said: Abu Muawiyah narrated to us; al-A'mash narrated to us, from Abu Sufyan, from Jabir, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was asked, "Which prayer is best?" He said: "Long standing." Abu Bakr said: Abu Muawiyah narrated to us, from al-A'mash.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا مَضَى شَطْرُ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ ثُلُثَاهُ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا فَيَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ سَائِلٍ يُعْطَى هَلْ مِنْ دَاعٍ يُسْتَجَابُ لَهُ هَلْ مِنْ مُسْتَغْفِرٍ يُغْفَرُ لَهُ حَتَّى يَنْفَجِرَ الصُّبْحُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Hurayra reported that when half the night, or two thirds of it, had passed, Allah descends to the lowest heaven and says: Is there anyone asking, to be given? Is there anyone calling, to be answered? Is there anyone seeking forgiveness, to be forgiven? This continues until dawn breaks. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to us; Abu al-Mughirah informed us; al-Awza'i narrated to us; Yahya narrated to us; Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "When half the night or two-thirds of it has passed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, descends to the lowest heaven and says: Is there anyone asking, so that he may be given? Is there anyone supplicating, so that he may be answered? Is there anyone seeking forgiveness, so that he may be forgiven? This continues until dawn breaks."

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَاضِرٌ أَبُو الْمُوَرِّعِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ مَرْجَانَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا لِشَطْرِ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ لِثُلُثِ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ فَيَقُولُ مَنْ يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ أَوْ يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ مَنْ يُقْرِضُ غَيْرَ عَدِيمٍ وَلاَ ظَلُومٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ ابْنُ مَرْجَانَةَ هُوَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَمَرْجَانَةُ أُمُّهُ ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ يَبْسُطُ يَدَيْهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى يَقُولُ مَنْ يُقْرِضُ غَيْرَ عَدُومٍ وَلاَ ظَلُومٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Hurayra reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Allah descends to the lowest heaven for half the night or the last third and says: Who is calling upon Me, that I may answer him, or asking Me, that I may give him? Then He says: Who will lend to One who is neither poor nor unjust? The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Hajjaj ibn al-Sha'ir narrated to me; Muhadir, Abu al-Muwarri, narrated to us; Sa'd ibn Sa'id narrated to us, saying: Ibn Marjanah informed me, saying: I heard Abu Hurayrah say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "Allah descends to the lowest heaven at the middle of the night, or during the last third of the night, and says: Who is supplicating to Me, so that I may answer him? Or asking Me, so that I may give to him? Then He says: Who will lend to One who is neither in need nor unjust?" Muslim said: Ibn Marjanah is Sa'id ibn Abdullah, and Marjanah is his mother. Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to us; Ibn Wahb narrated to us, saying: Sulayman ibn Bilal informed me, from Sa'd ibn Sa'id, with this chain, and he added: "Then He stretches out His hands, Blessed and Exalted, and says: Who will lend to One who is neither in need nor unjust?"

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ ابْنَا أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنَىْ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَغَرِّ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ، يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ قَالاَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْهِلُ حَتَّى إِذَا ذَهَبَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الأَوَّلُ نَزَلَ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا فَيَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مُسْتَغْفِرٍ هَلْ مِنْ تَائِبٍ هَلْ مِنْ سَائِلٍ هَلْ مِنْ دَاعٍ حَتَّى يَنْفَجِرَ الْفَجْرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Said and Abu Hurayra reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Allah delays until the first third of the night has gone, then descends to the lowest heaven and says: Is there anyone seeking forgiveness, repenting, asking or calling, until dawn breaks? The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Uthman and Abu Bakr, the two sons of Abu Shaybah, and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Hanzali narrated to us, and this is the wording of the two sons of Abu Shaybah. Ishaq said: Jarir informed us; the other two said: Jarir narrated to us, from Mansur, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Agharr Abu Muslim, who transmitted it from Abu Sa'id and Abu Hurayrah. They both said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "Allah grants respite until, when the first third of the night has passed, He descends to the lowest heaven and says: Is there anyone seeking forgiveness? Is there anyone repenting? Is there anyone asking? Is there anyone supplicating? This continues until dawn breaks."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ قَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Abu Hurayra reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever stands in Ramadan in faith and seeking reward will be forgiven his previous sins. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, saying: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever stands in prayer during Ramadan with faith and seeking reward will be forgiven for his past sins."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ مِنْ جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ فَصَلَّى فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَصَلَّى رِجَالٌ بِصَلاَتِهِ فَأَصْبَحَ النَّاسُ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ بِذَلِكَ فَاجْتَمَعَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْهُمْ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي اللَّيْلَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ فَصَلَّوْا بِصَلاَتِهِ فَأَصْبَحَ النَّاسُ يَذْكُرُونَ ذَلِكَ فَكَثُرَ أَهْلُ الْمَسْجِدِ مِنَ اللَّيْلَةِ الثَّالِثَةِ فَخَرَجَ فَصَلَّوْا بِصَلاَتِهِ فَلَمَّا كَانَتِ اللَّيْلَةُ الرَّابِعَةُ عَجَزَ الْمَسْجِدُ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ فَلَمْ يَخْرُجْ إِلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَطَفِقَ رِجَالٌ مِنْهُمْ يَقُولُونَ الصَّلاَةَ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَخْرُجْ إِلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى خَرَجَ لِصَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ فَلَمَّا قَضَى الْفَجْرَ أَقْبَلَ عَلَى النَّاسِ ثُمَّ تَشَهَّدَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَخْفَ عَلَىَّ شَأْنُكُمُ اللَّيْلَةَ وَلَكِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَنْ تُفْرَضَ عَلَيْكُمْ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ فَتَعْجِزُوا عَنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Aisha reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed in the mosque during the night, and men prayed behind him. On the second night more gathered, and on the third the mosque became crowded. On the fourth night he did not come out, until he came for Fajr. After the prayer he said: Your situation was not hidden from me tonight, but I feared that the night prayer would be made obligatory for you and you would be unable to perform it. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me; Abdullah ibn Wahb informed us; Yunus ibn Yazid informed me, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Urwah ibn al-Zubayr informed me that Aishah informed him that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came out in the middle of the night and prayed in the mosque. Some men prayed along with his prayer. In the morning, people talked about it, and more of them gathered. The Messenger of Allah came out on the second night, and they prayed along with his prayer. In the morning, people spoke about it, and the people in the mosque grew in number on the third night. He came out, and they prayed along with his prayer. When the fourth night came, the mosque could no longer hold its people, but the Messenger of Allah did not come out to them. Some of them began saying, "The prayer!" The Messenger of Allah did not come out to them until he came out for the dawn prayer. When he had completed the dawn prayer, he turned to the people, pronounced the testimony of faith, then said: "To proceed: Your situation last night was not hidden from me, but I feared that the night prayer would be made obligatory for you and that you would be unable to keep up with it."

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ زِرٍّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ، يَقُولُ - وَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ يَقُولُ مَنْ قَامَ السَّنَةَ أَصَابَ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ - فَقَالَ أُبَىٌّ وَاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ إِنَّهَا لَفِي رَمَضَانَ - يَحْلِفُ مَا يَسْتَثْنِي - وَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ أَىُّ لَيْلَةٍ هِيَ ‏.‏ هِيَ اللَّيْلَةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَنَا بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقِيَامِهَا هِيَ لَيْلَةُ صَبِيحَةِ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ وَأَمَارَتُهَا أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ فِي صَبِيحَةِ يَوْمِهَا بَيْضَاءَ لاَ شُعَاعَ لَهَا ‏.‏
before: Ubayy ibn Ka'b said: By Allah, I know the Night of Decree. It is the night on which the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) commanded us to stand in prayer, the night before the twenty-seventh day. Its sign is that the sun rises the next morning white, without rays. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Mihran al-Razi narrated to us; al-Walid ibn Muslim narrated to us; al-Awza'i narrated to us; Abda narrated to me, from Zirr, who said: I heard Ubayy ibn Ka'b say, when it was said to him that Abdullah ibn Mas'ud said that whoever prays throughout the whole year will encounter the Night of Decree: Ubayy said: By Allah, besides whom there is no god, it is indeed in Ramadan. He swore without exception. By Allah, I know which night it is: it is the night on which the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) commanded us to stand in prayer. It is the night whose following morning is the twenty-seventh. Its sign is that the sun rises the morning after it, white and without rays.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَةَ بْنَ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ أُبَىٌّ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُهَا وَأَكْثَرُ عِلْمِي هِيَ اللَّيْلَةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقِيَامِهَا هِيَ لَيْلَةُ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ - وَإِنَّمَا شَكَّ شُعْبَةُ فِي هَذَا الْحَرْفِ - هِيَ اللَّيْلَةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَنَا بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي بِهَا صَاحِبٌ لِي عَنْهُ ‏.‏
before: Ubayy ibn Ka'b said: By Allah, I know the Night of Decree, and most of my knowledge is that it is the night which the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) commanded us to spend in prayer. It is the night of the twenty-seventh day. Shu'ba was uncertain about one wording, and said a companion had related it to him. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us; Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, saying: I heard Abda ibn Abi Lubabah relating from Zirr ibn Hubaysh, from Ubayy ibn Ka'b, who said concerning the Night of Decree: By Allah, I know it, and most of what I know is that it is the night on which the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) commanded us to stand in prayer. It is the twenty-seventh night. Shu'bah was uncertain about this wording. It is the night which the Messenger of Allah commanded us to observe. He said: A companion of mine related it to me from him.
