arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنْ عَبْدَةَ، وَعَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّجُودِ، سَمِعَا زِرَّ بْنَ حُبَيْشٍ، يَقُولُ سَأَلْتُ أُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ - رضى الله عنه - فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ أَخَاكَ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ يَقُولُ مَنْ يَقُمِ الْحَوْلَ يُصِبْ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ أَرَادَ أَنْ لاَ يَتَّكِلَ النَّاسُ أَمَا إِنَّهُ قَدْ عَلِمَ أَنَّهَا فِي رَمَضَانَ وَأَنَّهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ وَأَنَّهَا لَيْلَةُ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ حَلَفَ لاَ يَسْتَثْنِي أَنَّهَا لَيْلَةُ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ فَقُلْتُ بِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ تَقُولُ ذَلِكَ يَا أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ قَالَ بِالْعَلاَمَةِ أَوْ بِالآيَةِ الَّتِي أَخْبَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا تَطْلُعُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لاَ شُعَاعَ لَهَا ‏.‏
before: Ubayy ibn Ka'b said: Ibn Masud says that whoever stands in prayer the whole year will encounter the Night of Decree. May Allah have mercy on him; he wanted people not to rely on one night. He knew that it is in Ramadan, in the last ten nights, and on the twenty-seventh night. He swore without exception that it is the twenty-seventh night. When asked why, he said: Because of the sign the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) told us: the sun rises that day without rays. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Hatim and Ibn Abi Umar narrated this to us, both from Ibn Uyaynah. Ibn Hatim said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Abda and Asim ibn Abi al-Najud, who both heard Zirr ibn Hubaysh say: I asked Ubayy ibn Ka'b (may Allah be pleased with him), saying: Your brother Ibn Mas'ud says that whoever stands in prayer throughout the whole year will encounter the Night of Decree. He said: May Allah have mercy on him. He wanted people not to rely on that. He knows that it is in Ramadan, in the last ten nights, and that it is the twenty-seventh night. Then he swore without exception that it is the twenty-seventh night. I said: By what sign do you say that, Abu al-Mundhir? He said: By the sign, or the indication, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) told us: the sun rises on that day without rays.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَةَ، بْنَ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، - رضى الله عنه - قَالَ قَالَ أُبَىٌّ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُهَا - قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَأَكْبَرُ عِلْمِي - هِيَ اللَّيْلَةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقِيَامِهَا هِيَ لَيْلَةُ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ ‏.‏ وَإِنَّمَا شَكَّ شُعْبَةُ فِي هَذَا الْحَرْفِ هِيَ اللَّيْلَةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَنَا بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي بِهَا صَاحِبٌ لِي عَنْهُ ‏.‏
before: Ubayy ibn Ka'b said: By Allah, I know the Night of Decree. It is the night on which the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) commanded us to stand in prayer, the twenty-seventh night. Shu'ba was uncertain about one expression and said a companion had related it to him. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us; Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, saying: I heard Abda ibn Abi Lubabah relating from Zirr ibn Hubaysh, from Ubayy ibn Ka'b (may Allah be pleased with him). Ubayy said concerning the Night of Decree: By Allah, I know it. Shu'bah said: To the best of my knowledge, it is the night on which the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) commanded us to stand in prayer. It is the twenty-seventh night. Shu'bah was uncertain about this wording: "It is the night which the Messenger of Allah commanded us to observe." He said: A companion of mine related it to me from him.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، بَاتَ لَيْلَةً عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ - وَهِيَ خَالَتُهُ - قَالَ فَاضْطَجَعْتُ فِي عَرْضِ الْوِسَادَةِ وَاضْطَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَهْلُهُ فِي طُولِهَا فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى انْتَصَفَ اللَّيْلُ أَوْ قَبْلَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ اسْتَيْقَظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَعَلَ يَمْسَحُ النَّوْمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ الْعَشْرَ الآيَاتِ الْخَوَاتِمَ مِنْ سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى شَنٍّ مُعَلَّقَةٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْهَا فَأَحْسَنَ وُضُوءَهُ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَصَلَّى ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُمْتُ فَصَنَعْتُ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ ذَهَبْتُ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى رَأْسِي وَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي الْيُمْنَى يَفْتِلُهَا فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ أَوْتَرَ ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى جَاءَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas said: I stayed with Maymunah, the Mother of the Believers. I lay across the cushion while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and his family lay along it. He slept until around midnight, awoke, wiped sleep from his face, recited the closing ten verses of the family of Imran, performed excellent wudu from a hanging water-container, and prayed. Ibn Abbas did the same. When he stood beside him, the Messenger of Allah placed his right hand on his head and twisted his right ear. He prayed two units repeatedly, then witr, lay down until the caller came, prayed two light units, and went out to pray Fajr. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, saying: I read to Malik, from Makhramah ibn Sulayman, from Kurayb, the freedman of Ibn Abbas, that Ibn Abbas informed him that he spent a night at the home of Maymunah, the Mother of the Believers, who was his maternal aunt. He said: I lay across the pillow, while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and his family lay along its length. The Messenger of Allah slept until the middle of the night, or a little before or after it. He woke, began wiping sleep from his face with his hand, then recited the last ten verses of Surah Al Imran. Then he went to a hanging water-skin, performed ablution from it and did so well, then stood and prayed. Ibn Abbas said: I stood and did what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had done, then went and stood beside him. The Messenger of Allah placed his right hand on my head and took my right ear, twisting it. He prayed two units, then two, then two, then two, then two, then two, then performed witr. Then he lay down until the caller came. He stood, prayed two brief units, then went out and prayed dawn.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمُرَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْفِهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ ثُمَّ عَمَدَ إِلَى شَجْبٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَتَسَوَّكَ وَتَوَضَّأَ وَأَسْبَغَ الْوُضُوءَ وَلَمْ يُهْرِقْ مِنَ الْمَاءِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً ثُمَّ حَرَّكَنِي فَقُمْتُ ‏.‏ وَسَائِرُ الْحَدِيثِ نَحْوُ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏
before: The same report adds that the Prophet (peace be upon him) went to a water-container, used the tooth-stick, performed complete wudu with little water, and roused Ibn Abbas. The rest is like Malik's report. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Salamah al-Muradi narrated to me; Abdullah ibn Wahb narrated to us, from Iyad ibn Abdullah al-Fihri, from Makhramah ibn Sulayman, with this chain. He added: Then he went to a water vessel, used a tooth-stick, and performed ablution, doing it thoroughly. He used only a little water, then roused me and I stood up. The rest of the report is like Malik's report.

arabic: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، عَنْ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ نِمْتُ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَهَا تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ فَتَوَضَّأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَامَ فَصَلَّى فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ فَأَخَذَنِي فَجَعَلَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ فَصَلَّى فِي تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ نَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى نَفَخَ وَكَانَ إِذَا نَامَ نَفَخَ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَخَرَجَ فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ بُكَيْرَ بْنَ الأَشَجِّ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي كُرَيْبٌ بِذَلِكَ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas said: I slept at Maymunah's house while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was there. He performed wudu, stood to pray, and moved me from his left to his right. His prayer that night totaled thirteen units. He slept until he breathed heavily, then the caller came, and he went out to pray without renewing wudu. Kuraib had related this to Bukayr ibn al-Ashajj. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to me; Ibn Wahb narrated to us; Amr narrated to us, from Abd Rabbih ibn Sa'id, from Makhramah ibn Sulayman, from Kurayb, the freedman of Ibn Abbas, from Ibn Abbas, who said: I slept at the home of Maymunah, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), and the Messenger of Allah was with her that night. The Messenger of Allah performed ablution, then stood and prayed. I stood on his left, so he took hold of me and placed me on his right. He prayed thirteen units that night. Then the Messenger of Allah slept until he snored, for when he slept he would snore. Then the caller came to him, and he went out and prayed without performing ablution. Amr said: I related this to Bukayr ibn al-Ashajj, and he said: Kurayb related that to me.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ بِتُّ لَيْلَةً عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا إِذَا قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَيْقِظِينِي ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ الأَيْسَرِ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي فَجَعَلَنِي مِنْ شِقِّهِ الأَيْمَنِ فَجَعَلْتُ إِذَا أَغْفَيْتُ يَأْخُذُ بِشَحْمَةِ أُذُنِي - قَالَ - فَصَلَّى إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ احْتَبَى حَتَّى إِنِّي لأَسْمَعُ نَفَسَهُ رَاقِدًا فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ الْفَجْرُ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas said: I stayed with my aunt Maymunah and asked her to wake me when the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) rose. He rose, and I stood at his left. He took my hand and moved me to his right. Whenever I dozed, he took hold of my earlobe. He prayed eleven units, then sat with his legs folded until I could hear his breathing. When dawn became clear, he prayed two light units. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to us; Ibn Abi Fudayk informed us; al-Dahhak narrated to us, from Makhramah ibn Sulayman, from Kurayb, the freedman of Ibn Abbas, from Ibn Abbas, who said: I spent a night at my aunt Maymunah bint al-Harith's home and said to her: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) gets up, wake me. The Messenger of Allah got up, and I stood on his left side. He took my hand and placed me on his right. Whenever I dozed, he would take hold of my earlobe. He prayed eleven units, then sat with his arms around his knees, and I could hear his breathing while he slept. When dawn became clear to him, he prayed two brief units.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، - عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ بَاتَ عِنْدَ خَالَتِهِ مَيْمُونَةَ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْ شَنٍّ مُعَلَّقٍ وُضُوءًا خَفِيفًا - قَالَ وَصَفَ وُضُوءَهُ وَجَعَلَ يُخَفِّفُهُ وَيُقَلِّلُهُ - قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُمْتُ فَصَنَعْتُ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ جِئْتُ فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ فَأَخْلَفَنِي فَجَعَلَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ فَنَامَ حَتَّى نَفَخَ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ بِلاَلٌ فَآذَنَهُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَخَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَهَذَا لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاصَّةً لأَنَّهُ بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَنَامُ عَيْنَاهُ وَلاَ يَنَامُ قَلْبُهُ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas said: I stayed with Maymunah. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) rose at night, performed a light wudu from a hanging water-container, and I did the same. I stood at his left, and he moved me to his right. He prayed, lay down and slept until he breathed heavily. Bilal called him to prayer, and he went out and prayed Fajr without renewing wudu. Sufyan said: This was specific to the Prophet, because we were told that his eyes slept but his heart did not. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ibn Abi Umar and Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to us, from Ibn Uyaynah. Ibn Abi Umar said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Kurayb, the freedman of Ibn Abbas, from Ibn Abbas, that he spent a night at his aunt Maymunah's home. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) got up during the night, performed a light ablution from a hanging water-skin, and, as the narrator described his ablution, he made it lighter and used less water. Ibn Abbas said: I got up and did what the Prophet (peace be upon him) had done, then came and stood on his left. He moved me to his right, prayed, then lay down and slept until he snored. Then Bilal came and announced the prayer to him. He went out and prayed dawn without performing ablution. Sufyan said: This was particular to the Prophet (peace be upon him), because we have been told that the Prophet's eyes sleep but his heart does not.

arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ بِتُّ فِي بَيْتِ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ فَبَقَيْتُ كَيْفَ يُصَلِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - فَقَامَ فَبَالَ ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَكَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ نَامَ ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى الْقِرْبَةِ فَأَطْلَقَ شِنَاقَهَا ثُمَّ صَبَّ فِي الْجَفْنَةِ أَوِ الْقَصْعَةِ فَأَكَبَّهُ بِيَدِهِ عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا حَسَنًا بَيْنَ الْوُضُوءَيْنِ ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي فَجِئْتُ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ - قَالَ - فَأَخَذَنِي فَأَقَامَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ فَتَكَامَلَتْ صَلاَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ نَامَ حَتَّى نَفَخَ وَكُنَّا نَعْرِفُهُ إِذَا نَامَ بِنَفْخِهِ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَصَلَّى فَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ أَوْ فِي سُجُودِهِ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورًا وَأَمَامِي نُورًا وَخَلْفِي نُورًا وَفَوْقِي نُورًا وَتَحْتِي نُورًا وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا أَوْ قَالَ وَاجْعَلْنِي نُورًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas said: I stayed at Maymunah's house to observe how the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed. He rose, relieved himself, washed his face and hands, performed a good wudu, and prayed. He moved me from his left to his right, and his prayer totaled thirteen units. He slept until he breathed heavily, then prayed and supplicated: O Allah, place light in my heart, my hearing, my sight, to my right, to my left, before me, behind me, above me and below me, and make light for me, or make me light. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us; Muhammad, who is Ibn Ja'far, narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, from Salamah, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas, who said: I spent the night in the home of my aunt Maymunah, watching how the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed. He got up, urinated, washed his face and hands, then slept. Then he went to the water-skin, loosened its strap, poured water into a large bowl or basin and tipped it over with his hand. He performed a good ablution, somewhere between the two ablutions. Then he stood to pray. I came and stood beside him, on his left, so he took hold of me and placed me on his right. The Messenger of Allah's prayer then amounted to thirteen units. He slept until he snored, and we knew he was asleep by his snoring. Then he went out for the prayer and prayed, saying during his prayer or prostration: "O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light to my right, light to my left, light before me, light behind me, light above me, light beneath me, and grant me light," or he said: "Make me light."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، ‏.‏ قَالَ سَلَمَةُ فَلَقِيتُ كُرَيْبًا فَقَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ غُنْدَرٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَاجْعَلْنِي نُورًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَشُكَّ ‏.‏
before: The same report from Ibn Abbas says: Maymunah was his aunt, the Prophet (peace be upon him) came, and the report was related with the same wording. It adds: Make me light, without uncertainty. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to me; al-Nadr ibn Shumayl informed us; Shu'bah informed us; Salamah ibn Kuhayl narrated to us, from Bukayr, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas. Salamah said: I met Kurayb, and he said: Ibn Abbas said: I was at my aunt Maymunah's home when the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came. He then related a report like Gundar's report and said: "And make me light." He did not express doubt.

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَهَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رِشْدِينٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ بِتُّ عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ غَسْلَ الْوَجْهِ وَالْكَفَّيْنِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَتَى الْقِرْبَةَ فَحَلَّ شِنَاقَهَا فَتَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا بَيْنَ الْوُضُوءَيْنِ ثُمَّ أَتَى فِرَاشَهُ فَنَامَ ثُمَّ قَامَ قَوْمَةً أُخْرَى فَأَتَى الْقِرْبَةَ فَحَلَّ شِنَاقَهَا ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا هُوَ الْوُضُوءُ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏"‏ وَاجْعَلْنِي نُورًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas said: I stayed with Maymunah. The report is similar, but it does not mention washing the face and hands. It says that the Prophet went to the water-container, performed a moderate wudu, slept, then rose again, performed complete wudu, and said: Increase my light for me. It does not mention: Make me light. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Hannad ibn al-Sari said: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from Sa'id ibn Masruq, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from Abu Rashdin, the freedman of Ibn Abbas, from Ibn Abbas, who said: I spent the night at my aunt Maymunah's. He related the report and did not mention washing the face and hands. Instead, he said: Then he went to the water-skin, loosened its strap and performed an ablution between the two ablutions. Then he went to his bed and slept. Then he got up once again, went to the water-skin, loosened its strap, and performed the ablution, which was the full ablution. He said: "Make my light great." He did not mention: "And make me light."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَلْمَانَ الْحَجْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُقَيْلِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، أَنَّ سَلَمَةَ بْنَ كُهَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ كُرَيْبًا حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ بَاتَ لَيْلَةً عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْقِرْبَةِ فَسَكَبَ مِنْهَا فَتَوَضَّأَ وَلَمْ يُكْثِرْ مِنَ الْمَاءِ وَلَمْ يُقَصِّرْ فِي الْوُضُوءِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَفِيهِ قَالَ وَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَتَئِذٍ تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ كَلِمَةً ‏.‏ قَالَ سَلَمَةُ حَدَّثَنِيهَا كُرَيْبٌ فَحَفِظْتُ مِنْهَا ثِنْتَىْ عَشْرَةَ وَنَسِيتُ مَا بَقِيَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورًا وَمِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَىَّ نُورًا وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُورًا وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas said: I spent a night with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). He rose, poured water from a water-container, performed wudu without using too much or too little water, and prayed. The report says that he made a supplication of nineteen words, of which Kuraib remembered twelve: O Allah, place light in my heart, on my tongue, in my hearing, in my sight, above me, below me, to my right, to my left, before me and behind me; place light in my soul and increase my light. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu al-Tahir narrated to me; Ibn Wahb narrated to us, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Salman al-Hajri, from Uqayl ibn Khalid, that Salamah ibn Kuhayl related to him that Kurayb related to him that Ibn Abbas spent a night with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). He said: The Messenger of Allah got up, went to the water-skin, poured some water from it and performed ablution. He did not use a lot of water, nor did he fall short in the ablution. He related the report. In it, he said: That night the Messenger of Allah supplicated with nineteen words. Salamah said: Kurayb related them to me. I memorised twelve of them and forgot the rest. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my tongue, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light above me, light beneath me, light to my right, light to my left, light before me, light behind me, place light within me, and make my light great."

arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي شَرِيكُ بْنُ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ رَقَدْتُ فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ لَيْلَةَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَهَا لأَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ صَلاَةُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِاللَّيْلِ - قَالَ - فَتَحَدَّثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ أَهْلِهِ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ رَقَدَ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَفِيهِ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَتَوَضَّأَ وَاسْتَنَّ ‏.‏
before: Ibn Abbas said: I slept in Maymunah's house on a night when the Prophet (peace be upon him) was there, to observe how he prayed at night. The Prophet spoke with his family for a while and then slept. The report continues that he rose, performed wudu and used the tooth-stick. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
after: Abu Bakr ibn Ishaq narrated to me; Ibn Abi Maryam informed us; Muhammad ibn Ja'far informed us; Sharik ibn Abi Nimr informed me, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas, who said: I slept in Maymunah's house on a night when the Prophet (peace be upon him) was with her, so that I could see how the Prophet prayed at night. The Prophet spoke with his family for a while, then slept. He related the report, and in it: Then he got up, performed ablution and used a tooth-stick.
